jobs.title: Project Manager - UX Research Vendor Operations
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Project Manager to support a high volume UX Research organization. This individual will own a portfolio of vendor engagements from initial intake through contract execution, purchase order issuance, and invoicing.



This is an ownership role rather than a traditional project support position. You will be accountable for keeping every engagement moving, proactively following up with stakeholders, identifying and resolving blockers, and communicating progress before being asked.



The team supports more than **700 UX Research projects annually**, creating an opportunity to work across a broad portfolio of high value research initiatives while gaining early visibility into products and experiences being developed across the organization. You will join a collaborative and welcoming team where your ability to make an immediate impact is valued.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Serve as the primary point of contact and guide for UX Researchers navigating vendor and procurement processes
* Own UX Research vendor engagements from intake through SOW creation and execution, PO issuance, and invoicing
* Manage a portfolio of active engagements and ensure each case continues progressing toward completion
* Coordinate across researchers, contract associates, vendors, approvers, and leadership
* Proactively follow up with stakeholders and create urgency when actions or approvals are outstanding
* Identify blockers quickly, recommend solutions, escalate appropriately, and drive issues through resolution
* Provide proactive written updates to managers and stakeholders covering progress, risks, dependencies, and blockers
* Anticipate stakeholder needs and potential issues before they delay an engagement
* Maintain accurate KPI and SLA tracking and ensure strong data integrity
* Maintain vendor resources, process documentation, team wikis, and toolkits
* Identify recurring friction within the intake to contract process and recommend process improvements
* Manage projects associated with implementing process improvements
* Provide guidance regarding compliance policies associated with vendor engagements

### **What Success Looks Like**



Success in this role requires a strong sense of ownership and urgency. You take action rather than waiting for direction, keep your commitments moving, and close the loop on outstanding items. Your manager and stakeholders know the status of your work because you communicate proactively, not because they need to ask.



You are comfortable operating independently in ambiguity, know when to escalate, and remain persistent when progress depends on someone else. Just as importantly, you bring empathy to the process and help internal stakeholders and external vendors navigate complex systems and competing priorities.


### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree
* 4 or more years of experience in project coordination, project management, program management, procurement, vendor management, or operations
* Demonstrated experience independently owning workstreams from beginning through completion
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects or cases across cross functional teams and external partners
* Strong ability to maintain momentum across a high volume portfolio with minimal day to day supervision
* Experience proactively communicating status, risks, and blockers through regular written updates
* Demonstrated experience using AI tools to increase productivity, efficiency, and overall throughput
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to adapt communication for peers, cross functional stakeholders, and senior leadership
* Ability to exercise sound judgment and make decisions in ambiguous situations
* Excellent organization, attention to detail, prioritization, and follow through

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience in procurement, sourcing, contracting, or vendor management
* Experience supporting research, R\&D, UX, or creative organizations
* Project or program management training or certification such as PMP or CAPM
* Experience with case management, ticketing, or workflow management systems
* Familiarity with UX Research or Research Operations


Pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, qualified applicants will be considered for assignment with arrest and conviction records. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness, meet client expectations, standards, and accompanying requirements, and safeguard business operations and company reputation.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**Integra Partners is seeking an experienced Implementation Manager to lead complex, post\-sale health plan implementations from initiation through operational handoff.** This role owns the implementation plan, client relationship, cross\-functional coordination, risks, decisions, and readiness activities required to deliver on time, within scope, and with a high\-quality client experience. The successful candidate brings direct health plan implementation experience and practical knowledge of claims operations, testing, and issue resolution.  

  

 **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Independently leads complex implementations for health plan clients and healthcare partners, from kickoff and requirements validation through testing, launch, stabilization, and transition to operations.
* Build and maintain the integrated implementation project plan, work breakdown structure, milestones, dependencies, decision log, risk and issue log, and executive status reporting.
* Serve as the primary implementation point of contact for external clients and coordinate internal teams across operations, claims, technology, network, clinical, finance, compliance, and other functional areas.
* Translate contractual commitments, requirements, operational workflows, and technical specifications into clear implementation requirements, owners, due dates, acceptance criteria, and signoffs.
* Lead claims\-related implementation activities, including workflow design, configuration validation, test scenario development, end\-to\-end claims testing, defect triage, reconciliation, and production readiness.
* Monitor timeline, scope, quality, budget, and resource needs; identify risks early and drive mitigation, escalation, and resolution with accountable owners.
* Facilitate internal and client\-facing meetings, document outcomes, and communicate concise status summaries, recommendations, decisions, and next steps to project teams and senior leadership.
* Ensure implementation documentation is complete and audit\-ready, including project plans, requirements, meeting materials, test evidence, approvals, lessons learned, and transition documentation.
* Apply a continuous\-improvement mindset to simplify processes, strengthen controls, and improve implementation quality and repeatability.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute to implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and best practices.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATION:**  

* 5\+ years of implementation, project management, client delivery, or related experience in healthcare, including direct responsibility for health plan or payer implementations.
* Demonstrated experience leading implementation work with health plans, including requirements, cross\-functional readiness, client governance, testing, launch, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Claims experience is required, with working knowledge of healthcare claims workflows, configuration, testing, adjudication outcomes, exception handling, reconciliation, and issue resolution.
* Experience managing multiple work\-streams, dependencies, risks, and executive\-level communications in a client\-facing environment.
* Ability to understand complex healthcare, operational, and technical concepts and translate them into clear business language and executable plans.
* Strong facilitation, organization, documentation, analytical problem\-solving, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with standard project management and productivity tools; ability to quickly learn company systems and processes.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability without direct authority.

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**  

* Experience with Durable Medical Equipment, Prosthetics, Orthotics, and Supplies (DMEPOS), including related benefits, provider or supplier workflows, claims, and operational considerations.
* Experience implementing network management, utilization management, provider network, or delegated services programs.
* Project management certification or formal project management methodology experience.
* Experience working in a highly regulated healthcare environment and handling confidential or sensitive information.

**EDUCATION AND ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**  

* Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 35%, based on business and client needs.

  

**SUCCESS IN THE ROLE:**  

  

First 6 months* Develop a strong understanding of the role, departmental policies, implementation tools, and assigned client programs.
* Establish effective working relationships with client and internal stakeholders and independently manage core implementation routines.
* Set measurable professional development and delivery goals.


By 12 months* Consistently lead complex health plan implementations with clear ownership, disciplined governance, and executive\-ready communication.
* Demonstrate strong command of claims implementation dependencies and drive issues through resolution and stabilization.
* Contribute knowledge, templates, lessons learned, and process improvements that strengthen the implementation function.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead major facility upgrade and modernization programs. The Project Manager will be responsible for the successful delivery of the project from planning and design through construction, commissioning, and closeout, acting on behalf of the owner to manage scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned industrial facilities professional with a strong background in waterfront and marine construction, and preferably direct experience in shipbuilding or ship repair environments. This person understands not only how industrial facilities are built, but how they operate, and can deliver capital improvements while keeping an active facility productive.

**Key Responsibilities**

**\- Project Leadership \& Planning**

* Serve as the primary point of accountability for overall project delivery, representing the owner's interests across all phases of work.
* Develop and maintain the project execution plan, including scope definition, work breakdown structure, phasing strategy, and delivery method.
* Plan and sequence construction to minimize disruption to ongoing facility operations, including vessel movements, production schedules, and dry docking activities.
* Lead project kickoff, progress, and executive\-level review meetings; prepare clear and timely reporting for owners, stakeholders, and funding agencies.

**\- Design Management**

* Manage engineering and design consultants through conceptual, preliminary, and final design phases.
* Conduct constructability, operability, and value engineering reviews to ensure designs meet functional, production, and budget requirements.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary design across civil, structural, geotechnical, marine, mechanical, electrical, and process disciplines.

**\- Procurement \& Contract Administration**

* Develop procurement strategies and bid packages; lead contractor and vendor prequalification, solicitation, evaluation, and negotiation.
* Administer design and construction contracts, including change orders, claims, pay applications, and dispute resolution.
* Manage long\-lead equipment procurement (e.g., cranes, shiplift or dry dock systems, transfer systems, power distribution, and shop equipment).

**\- Cost \& Schedule Control**

* Establish and manage the project budget, cost forecasts, and cash flow projections.
* Develop and maintain integrated master schedules; monitor critical path, identify variances, and implement recovery plans.
* Track and report earned value and key performance indicators.

**\- Construction Oversight**

* Provide oversight of site construction activities, including marine works such as piers, wharves, bulkheads, dredging, and dry dock or shiplift foundations.
* Monitor contractor performance for compliance with plans, specifications, quality standards, and safety requirements.
* Lead testing, commissioning, certification, and turnover of facilities and systems to operations.

**\- Permitting, Compliance \& Stakeholder Coordination**

* Manage regulatory and environmental permitting, including coordination with the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, state and local agencies, and port authorities as applicable.
* Ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, environmental regulations, and funding or grant requirements.
* Coordinate with facility management, operations staff, labor representatives, public agencies, and community stakeholders.

**\- Risk \& Safety Management**

* Identify, assess, and actively manage project risks, maintaining a current risk register and mitigation plans.
* Promote and enforce a strong safety culture across all project participants, with particular attention to the hazards of active industrial and waterfront sites.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Civil, Structural, Mechanical, or Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of project management experience on large, complex capital projects, with at least 5 years on industrial facility projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing projects with capital values of $100 million or greater.
* Proven track record managing design consultants and construction contractors under a variety of delivery methods (design\-bid\-build, design\-eci\-build, EPC, etc).
* Strong command of cost control, scheduling (Primavera P6 or MS Project), and contract administration.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to executive leadership, boards, and government stakeholders.
* Ability to travel and work on\-site for extended periods as project needs require.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience in a shipbuilding or ship repair environment, whether in operations, facilities, engineering, or capital projects.
* Experience delivering waterfront and marine infrastructure, including piers, wharves, bulkheads, dredging, and dry docks, shiplifts, or other vessel transfer systems.
* Experience modernizing brownfield facilities while maintaining ongoing operations.

* Professional certification such as PMP, PE, or CCM.

**Key Competencies**

* Attention to detail balanced with a strategic, big\-picture perspective.

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  

**What to Expect:**  

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  

Candidates for this role should have Electronic Security Services Experience!
  
  

**How You’ll Contribute:**  

As a Senior Project Manager in Electronic Security Systems (ESS), you oversee all aspects of project execution—including scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client satisfaction—across the entire project lifecycle, from initiation to closure. You are accountable for the successful delivery of large\-scale, complex ESS projects, requiring effective delegation, diligent follow\-through, and assurance of key deliverables. Your role centers on harnessing subject matter expertise, driving decision\-making, and aligning cross\-functional teams, all while maintaining clear and impactful communication with stakeholders and executive leadership.
  
  

The Sr PM is responsible for overseeing and performing project management functions with respect to cost, quality and schedule. The Sr PM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project management activities. This position provides oversight and direction to a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
  
  

As a primary interface to the client, the Sr. Project Manager develops a strong long\-term relationship \- managing the client relationship, including expectations, communications and satisfaction.
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

**Daily activities include:**  

Leads the delivery of physical security systems by managing implementation, coordinating teams, and ensuring compliance with specifications, timelines, and quality standards.
  
  

Demonstrates expertise in the delivery and integration of physical security technologies, including closed\-circuit television (CCTV) systems, electronic access control systems, intrusion detection alarms, and perimeter security solutions.
  
  

Must possess a strong understanding of general construction sequencing and its impact on project scheduling, risk mitigation, and potential delays. Responsible for identifying, qualifying, and quantifying construction\-related risks, and communicating those risks clearly and effectively to the stakeholders in written form to support proactive planning and resolution.
  
  

Collaborates in design reviews to support accurate and comprehensive field documentation across project teams.
  
  

Demonstrated proficiency in developing schedules, establishing project baselines, and identifying, qualifying, and quantifying deviations, with clear communication of impacts to the client.
  
  

Responsible for coordinating field verification of prospective work sites, ensuring compliance with quality control requirements, confirming readiness, and documenting site conditions.
  
  

Demonstrates a strong ability to monitor and control the financial health of projects, including tracking budgets, costs, and margins. Proactively identifies financial risks and implements corrective actions to prevent margin erosion, ensuring profitability and alignment with financial targets.
  
  

Proactively identifies potential customer concerns and addresses them before they escalate into issues. Delivers thoughtful, comprehensive solutions to both clients and internal stakeholders, fostering trust and ensuring a smooth project experience.
  
  

Provides flexible, on\-demand support to team members, proactively assisting with tasks, problem\-solving, and resource coordination to help ensure project success and team efficiency. Demonstrates a collaborative mindset and a willingness to step in wherever needed to keep work progressing and goals on track.
  
  

Partners with the site supervisor to establish and drive the project’s work plan and schedule, ensuring alignment with overall project goals and timelines.
  
  

Coordinates stakeholder activities to enable system programming and final checkout of systems.
  
Requires proven experience in coordinating all critical activities involved in the successful commissioning of security systems, including planning, execution, testing, and documentation. The candidate must ensure systems are fully operational, meet design specifications, and are ready for client handover.
  
  

Works closely with the site supervisor, general contractor, and end user to develop and manage a comprehensive punch list of outstanding tasks following substantial completion. Ensures timely resolution of remaining items to support project closeout and client satisfaction.
  
  

Facilitates project turnover and training sessions with clients, and service team.

About Clutch Affiliate

Clutch Affiliate is a women\-owned affiliate and partnership marketing agency working with CPG and DTC brands across Amazon, DTC/network affiliate, publisher affiliate, TikTok Shop, and PR affiliate. With remote offices in Tampa, Florida and Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, we run lean and move fast, both with our clients and with each other. If you like clear ownership over your work and don't want corporate red tape, you'll fit in here.

The Role

We're looking for a Project Manager / Admin who can be the connective tissue across Clutch. This role oversees the moving pieces across our full client roster and supports our co\-founders directly, keeping projects, deadlines, and next steps on track internally and with clients. You'll need to be organized, proactive, and comfortable owning the details other people forget to track.

This is not primarily an affiliate marketing execution role. Affiliate marketing knowledge is a bonus, not a requirement, we're happy to train that piece. What matters most is that you're a sharp project manager and administrator who can keep multiple clients and workstreams moving without being told twice.

We're not currently tied to a specific project management platform. If you have strong experience with a PM tool you love (Asana, ClickUp, Monday, Notion, or otherwise) and think it would serve us well, we're genuinely open to adopting it.

If it's a mutual fit, there's real room to grow into full\-time as our client base expands.

What You'll Do

\- Serve as the central point of organization across all client accounts, tracking deliverables, deadlines, and next steps

\- Provide direct administrative support to Clutch's co\-founders, managing schedules, priorities, and follow\-through

\- Keep internal projects on track, flagging what's falling behind before it becomes a problem

\- Coordinate across the team to make sure client needs are being met on time

\- Build and maintain systems (trackers, checklists, calendars) that keep the agency organized as it scales

\- Sit in on client calls as needed to capture next steps and keep projects moving

\- Support affiliate program operations where needed (we'll train you on this as it comes up)

\- Bring ideas to the table on how to make Clutch run more efficiently, not just execute on someone else's

What You Need

\- Strong project management skills, comfortable juggling multiple clients and priorities at once

\- Excellent organizational skills and follow\-through, nothing falls through the cracks on your watch

\- Comfortable providing high\-level administrative support to founders

\- Self\-starter energy. We're not going to micromanage you; we need someone who sees what needs doing and does it

\- Clear, confident communicator, both internally and with clients

\- Genuine interest in helping a small agency run well and grow

Nice to Have

\- Familiarity with affiliate/publisher marketing (CJ, Avantlink, AWIN, or Impact)

\- PR affiliate experience

\- Experience with a PM platform you'd advocate for us adopting

Hours and Structure

Flexible and remote. Potential to expand to full\-time based on performance and agency growth.

Pay

Hourly, based on experience.

To Apply

To help us see who reads instructions carefully, please include the following when you apply:

1\. In your cover letter or application message, name one podcast episode Clutch Affiliate has appeared on (you'll find this on our website at www.clutchaffiliate.com).

2\. Include the phrase "Growth Partner" somewhere in your subject line or application message.

Applications that skip these steps will not be considered.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 8\.0 – 10\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
As a founding member of our rapidly evolving Project Management team, you will provide end\-to\-end ownership of complex, high\-impact new product development (NPD) programs. You will lead multiple cross\-functional teams through the NPD process from concept to retail launch, ensuring projects are delivered on time, on cost, and on spec.


Because our PMO is a newly established function, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our operational standards, creating deep and meaningful partnerships companywide, and demonstrating project management's strategic value. You serve as a strategic partner, facilitator, and escalation point—driving alignment at leadership levels, navigating high ambiguity, and setting the standard for execution excellence.

**Responsibilities**


Responsibilities are executed in alignment with PMO standards, methodologies, and the Project Management Competency Matrix. Duties include but are not limited to:

* **Project \& Timeline Management:** Own and drive multiple large or complex NPD programs simultaneously through the Phase Gate process. Develop and manage integrated timelines, anticipate delivery risks, and lead cross‑functional teams through trade‑off decisions to protect timing, cost, and scope. This is a leadership role focused on ownership and outcomes, not task execution for other functions. Actively help define and refine our NPD gates and milestones as our PMO matures.
* **Product \& Cross‑Functional Leadership:** Partner closely with Product Managers, Marketing, R\&D, Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, and Creative at both working and leadership levels. Facilitate high‑impact meetings, drive decision‑making, and ensure alignment on priorities, commitments, and deliverables across functions.
* **Advanced Risk Management:** Proactively identify, assess, and manage risks across programs with significant business impact. Develop mitigation and contingency plans, escalate appropriately, and prevent late‑stage surprises through early visibility and action.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Provide clear, concise, and strategic project updates to cross‑functional leaders and stakeholders. Influence alignment and decision‑making by clearly communicating risks, trade‑offs, and recommendations.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Lead efforts to strengthen PMO processes, tools, and standards. Identify systemic gaps across teams and drive improvements that enable more predictable, efficient, and scalable product launches. Help design, pilot, and champion new PMO tools, templates, and communication cadences that make the team more efficient.

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree required (Business, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, or similar).
* Typically 7–10\+ years of professional experience, including extensive ownership of complex NPD programs.

**Technical Skills**

* Expert proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and project management tools.

**Management Skills**

* **Detail‑Oriented:** Manages complex, interdependent project details across multiple programs, anticipating downstream impacts to scope, timing, cost, and quality. Identifies patterns and systemic risks early to prevent escalation and late‑stage disruption.
* **Communication:** Provides clear, concise, and strategic verbal and written communication across all levels of the organization, including senior leadership. Translates complex project dynamics into decision‑ready insights that drive alignment and action.
* **Problem‑Solving:** Anticipates obstacles before they emerge, quickly assesses root causes, and guides teams toward practical, durable solutions that balance business priorities and execution realities.
* **Cross‑Functional Fluency:** Demonstrates deep fluency across Brand, Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, and other partner functions. Uses this understanding to drive effective collaboration, sound trade‑offs, and strong execution outcomes.
* **Adaptability \& Ambiguity:** Thrives in high‑pressure, fast‑changing environments with competing priorities. Leads teams confidently through ambiguity, maintaining momentum and focus despite shifting inputs or incomplete information.

**Interpersonal Skills**

* **Mediator, not Participant:** Leads as an objective, unbiased truth teller who balances competing functional priorities and interests. Facilitates tough conversations, surfaces hard truths early, and drives fair, informed outcomes aligned to overall business goals.
* **Conflict Navigation:** Navigates complex, high‑stakes conflicts across teams and leadership levels with sound judgment. Resolves competing priorities constructively, escalating appropriately to protect project outcomes.
* **Calm in the Storm:** Maintains composure, clarity, and decisiveness during periods of significant pressure or uncertainty. Sets the tone for teams, helping others remain focused and productive during tight deadlines or critical moments.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Builds strong, trust‑based relationships across the organization and influences outcomes through credibility and expertise. Effectively drives commitment, accountability, and follow‑through without relying on formal authority.
* **Attention to Detail:** Continuously monitors program health at both project and portfolio levels, ensuring small gaps or inconsistencies are identified early and do not scale into larger delivery or quality issues.

**Pay and Benefits**  

  

US$130,000\.00 \- US$140,000\.00 Annually  

  

Final compensation offered will be determined based on a number of job\-related factors, including the candidate's skills, experience, and qualifications. Employees in this role are eligible to participate in the company's benefits program, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company matching, accrued vacation, floating holidays, and designated company holidays.


Offer contingent on successful completion of a background check.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About MonetizeMore**
----------------------


MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture\-first organization driven by four core values: **Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen** (Continuous Improvement), and **Collaboration**. We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.

  

**About the Role**
------------------


The company is seeking an experienced, systems\-driven **Business Operations Manager** to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end\-to\-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes.  

  

The **Business Operations Manager** will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross\-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization\-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data\- and AI\-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems.

  

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **1\. Process Kaizen \& SOP Governance**

* ### **Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented.**

### **2\. Project Management \& Visibility**

* ### **Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to\-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company\-wide model with long\-term integration into BL L10s.**

### **3\. Product Rollout Support**

* ### **Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go\-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model.**

### **4\. Cross\-Departmental \& Enterprise Client Enablement**

* ### **Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross\-functional commitments visible and actioned.**

### **5\. Data \& Spreadsheet Management**

* ### **Own data pulls and spreadsheet\-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re\-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental.**


**Who You Are**
---------------

* **The Experienced Operator:** You have 4\+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high\-data\-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC).
* **The Systems Builder:** You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably.
* **Data\- and AI\-Fluent:** You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand\-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work.
* **Comfortable with Ambiguity:** You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process.
* **Direct Communicator:** You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **True Flexibility:** Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle.
* **Professional Development:** Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.

This role contributes to SNHU's information security risk management program through the application of qualitative and quantitative evaluation of threats, vulnerabilities, and security control effectiveness across systems, vendors, technologies, and business processes.

* Collaborate with information security, privacy, compliance, audit, and business stakeholders to coordinate and document risk mitigation activities and track remediation efforts in alignment with regulatory requirements, risk management frameworks, institutional policies, and organizational priorities.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***


The Pharmacy Fraud Program Manager is a member of the Special Investigations Unit responsible for detecting, validating, and investigating suspected fraudulent activity within the pharmacy benefit — including prescribing, dispensing, and pharmacy claims activity — across a wide range of internal and external data sources. This role centers on rigorous data validation — reconciling, cross\-referencing, and stress\-testing information drawn from numerous systems to confirm accuracy, surface inconsistencies, and build defensible investigative findings.


The ideal candidate pairs a deeply inquisitive, investigative mindset with strong analytical discipline and brings genuine pharmacy depth: fluency with pharmacy claims data and pharmacy benefit operations, including NCPDP claim fields, NDCs, quantity and days supply logic, formulary and prior authorization concepts, and prescriber and pharmacy identifiers (NPI, DEA, state license), together with a working knowledge of the regulatory framework governing pharmacy fraud, waste, and abuse.


They are fluent in recognizing pharmacy fraud triggers and red flags — prescribing and dispensing outliers, controlled substance and overutilization patterns, and pharmacy billing schemes — and they actively leverage AI\-assisted detection and validation tools to scale their analysis, prioritize cases, and reduce false positives. This person is comfortable asking hard questions, following the data wherever it leads, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable conclusions.


In addition to the core responsibilities of the Fraud Program Manager role, this position serves as the primary owner of the CFWA relationship with our pharmacy benefit manager, coordinating referrals, reporting, and oversight activities between the organization and CVS. This person will work side by side with the Fraud Program Manager on overall fraud detection and scheme identification.

***Your responsibilities and impact will include:***

**CFWA Relationship Management — CVS**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and relationship owner for the CFWA program with CVS, managing day\-to\-day coordination, escalations, and information exchange.
* Manage the intake, routing, and disposition of CFWA referrals to and from CVS, tracking each referral through resolution and ensuring turnaround times and documentation standards are met.
* Lead recurring CFWA governance touchpoints (e.g., joint operating and workgroup meetings), setting agendas, tracking action items, and driving issues to closure.
* Review CVS\-provided FWA reporting, investigative summaries, audit results, and recovery activity for completeness, accuracy, and consistency with source claims data; challenge findings that are not supported by the data.
* Monitor CVS performance against contractual, delegated, and regulatory FWA obligations; identify gaps, request corrective action, and escalate deficiencies to compliance and leadership.
* Track pharmacy\-level actions performed by CVS under the PBM agreement — including pharmacy audits, prepayment review, claim edits, recoveries, and network termination — confirming that agreed actions were taken and applied correctly, and escalating where they were not.

**Data Validation \& Source Reconciliation**

* Validate, reconcile, and cross\-reference data drawn from numerous and disparate sources — pharmacy and medical claims systems, PBM data feeds, prior authorization and rejected\-claim data, eligibility and enrollment systems, prescriber and pharmacy provider files, third\-party databases, public records, watchlists, internal applications, and external vendor feeds.
* Identify discrepancies, anomalies, and inconsistencies across data sets — including NDC, quantity, days supply, DAW, prescriber NPI, DEA number, and dispensing pharmacy mismatches — and determine whether they indicate error, manipulation, or fraud.
* Establish and maintain data integrity standards for investigations, ensuring findings are accurate, complete, and defensible.
* Trace data lineage across internal systems and PBM\-supplied files, corroborating information against authoritative sources to confirm or refute investigative hypotheses.

**AI\-Assisted Detection \& Validation**

* Use AI\- and machine learning–driven detection tools to flag suspicious patterns, score risk, and surface high\-priority cases for review.
* Validate AI\-generated alerts and model outputs against source claims and clinical data, distinguishing genuine fraud indicators from false positives, data artifacts, and legitimate clinical variation.
* Provide structured feedback to analytics, vendor, and PBM partners to improve model accuracy, tuning, and rule logic over time.
* Stay current on emerging AI\-enabled fraud schemes (e.g., synthetic identities, deepfakes, generated prescriptions or prior authorization documentation, fraudulent e\-prescribing credentials) and adapt detection approaches accordingly.

**Pharmacy Fraud Detection, Triggers \& Red Flags**

* Apply deep knowledge of pharmacy fraud triggers, red flags, and typologies — including prescribing and dispensing patterns — to proactively identify suspicious activity before it escalates.
* Develop, refine, and document indicators and detection criteria based on emerging schemes and investigative learnings.
* Investigate referrals and self\-sourced leads, building complete case referrals supported by validated evidence.

* Prepare clear written summaries and present findings to leadership, business partners, legal, and, when appropriate, law enforcement or regulatory bodies.

H2 Performance Consulting (H2\), a high\-growth technology firm, is seeking a Senior Project Manager to support a U.S. government client. The Senior Project Manager will lead complex Federal projects, programs, and transformation initiatives from planning through implementation and closeout. The position integrates mission requirements, scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, resources, governance, contractor performance, and stakeholder decisions to deliver measurable outcomes within the Federal operating environment. This is a fully remote position supporting a government client. The position requires U.S. citizenship and an active Public Trust clearance at the time of application. This position is contingent upon contract award, final staffing requirements, security eligibility, certification requirements, and customer approval, where applicable.

  

Key Responsibilities:


* Plan and lead complex projects or programs involving multiple workstreams, offices, bureaus, commands, contractors, or stakeholder organizations.
* Establish the project management approach, integrated schedule, work breakdown structure, governance cadence, performance baseline, quality controls, and reporting processes.
* Manage scope, schedule, cost, staffing, dependencies, risks, issues, assumptions, decisions, changes, deliverables, acceptance, and closeout.

* Lead multidisciplinary Government and contractor teams and coordinate the work of functional, technical, data, cybersecurity, acquisition, financial, and operational specialists.

* Develop forecasts, corrective action plans, alternatives, decision papers, executive briefings, and Government\-ready status reports.

* Support implementation, organizational change, communications, training, transition, adoption, benefits realization, and sustainment planning.
* Align project objectives, outcomes, and acceptance criteria with agency mission, policy, acquisition strategy, funding, and operational priorities.
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, resource forecasts, risk and issue registers, action logs, decision logs, and performance dashboards.
* Monitor progress using tools like GitHub or Jira with appropriate predictive, adaptive, Agile, or hybrid delivery methods and recommend timely management action when performance varies from the baseline.
* Coordinate dependencies among policy, business processes, workforce, data, technology, security, privacy, accessibility, procurement, and deployment activities.
* Manage communications with Government leads, contracting personnel, executives, end users, vendors, and partner organizations.
* Protect procurement\-sensitive, proprietary, personally identifiable, controlled, unclassified, and other sensitive information in accordance with applicable requirements.
* Promote practical continuous improvement while maintaining accountability for scope, decisions, approvals, and outcomes.

  

**Requirements**  

Required Qualifications:

  

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in business, public administration, project management, engineering, information systems, or related field; master's degree preferred.
* 10\+ years of progressively responsible project, program, operations, or management\-consulting experience.
* 10\+ years supporting Federal civilian, defense, intelligence, military, or comparable public\-sector organizations.

Preferred Qualifications:

Built by enterprise software engineers and compliance experts, we provide comprehensive ACA reporting and compliance services. jobs.description:
In the journey of life, your career should make a difference.


At Inizio Evoke, we come together—to do the best work, in the best possible place. We're all in. Because it's everyone's role to make health more human™.


**About the Role**


We're looking for a Senior Program Manager to run the operating rhythm of Operatev — Inizio Evoke's enterprise AI platform — from the inside out.


This is a high\-visibility, cross\-functional role responsible for keeping the program on schedule and its status transparent. You'll own the connective tissue: sequencing work across Product, Development, Change \& Enablement, Support, Operations, Business Transformation, and Commercialization so that nothing blocks on an unowned handoff and everyone is working from the same picture of where things stand.


You will sit at the center of a program that is building and rolling out a platform to 1,200 people. That means competing priorities, real dependencies, and a delivery pace that doesn't slow down. You will bring strong program management fundamentals in a product development environment, thrive on clarity and structure, and know how to translate complex cross\-functional realities into reporting that actually drives decisions.


This is a remote role reporting to the Program Lead.

  



**What You'll Do:**


***Own Cross\-Team Sequencing***


* Map dependencies across functions — what depends on what, in what order — and monitor progress against that sequence
* Ensure handoffs are owned, surface unresolved blockers early, and drive items to closure or escalation
* Maintain visibility into the implications of sequencing decisions for Product, Development, and all downstream functions

***Run the Quarterly Planning Cycle***


* Gather functional inputs across all workstreams
* Facilitate commitment\-setting and document outcomes
* Translate quarterly commitments into trackable milestones and hold functions accountable to them

***Track Program Resourcing***


* Maintain visibility into where capacity is going against what's committed and manage the program's calendar to proactively address capacity challenges
* Surface trends and anomalies to program leadership before they become problems
* Oversee recruitment process, meeting with talent acquisition for updates and ensuring timely progress through stakeholder participation

***Set and Hold Stage Gate Standards***


* Define the gates work passes through and what evidence clears each one
* Keep functional cadences in sync without taking over internal functional processes (sprint practices, capability lifecycle, etc.)

***Run Delivery Forums***


* Facilitate the weekly initiative update and risk review
* Maintain the risk register and drive items to resolution or escalation
* Track progress against quarterly commitments and hold the reporting cadence

***Define Reporting Standards***


* Establish and maintain the data taxonomy that governs how each function reports its metrics
* Ensure functional outputs roll into one consistent program\-level picture rather than competing narratives

***Own Executive Reporting***


* Prepare and deliver the synthesized program view for executive and steering committee audiences
* Surface where delivery reality constrains what's being asked — clearly and with context

  

**What You'll Bring:**


* 7\+ years of experience in program management, delivery management, or PMO leadership — ideally within a technology platform, transformation, or product delivery context
* Experience running formal planning cycles (quarterly or release\-based) and translating outputs into trackable commitments
* Track record of building and maintaining executive\-level reporting that is trusted and acted on
* Comfortable managing budget and resource visibility — not ownership, but accurate tracking and surfacing of variance
* Background in professional services, agency, consulting, or regulated industry preferred (healthcare, life sciences, or similar)

***Skills***


* Strong program and project management fundamentals — dependency mapping, risk management, stage gates, and cadence management
* Highly organized: you make things visible, structured, and easy to act on
* Strong written and verbal communication; able to translate complexity into clean reporting without losing accuracy
* Comfortable operating in agile/iterative environments where priorities shift and the plan evolves
* Skilled facilitator — able to run productive cross\-functional forums without letting them drift

***Mindset***


* You keep things moving without needing to own everything
* You surface problems early and bring them forward with enough context for a decision
* You enforce standards consistently — not rigidly, but reliably
* You understand the difference between tracking and deciding, and you stay in your lane while making it easy for others to stay in theirs

  

**What We Offer**


* A central, high\-impact role in a program building something genuinely new — an enterprise AI platform designed to change how a 1,200\-person agency does its work
* Direct visibility to executive and steering committee leadership
* A cross\-functional operating environment where your work touches every part of the program
* The opportunity to define and own the operating standards that the program runs on

Inizio Evoke provides an exciting and flexible work environment, great compensation packages and outstanding company paid benefits including medical, dental, 401(k), tuition reimbursement and flexible time off.


*We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.*

Program Manager, JCC Maccabi  

JCC Association  

520 8th Ave  

\#1204  

New York, NY 10018
**Principal Responsibilities:**
===============================


**Position:** Program Manager, JCC Maccabi


**Team:** JCC Maccabi


**Reports to:** Program Director, JCC Maccabi


**Summary**
-----------


JCC Maccabi(r) is a signature program of the JCC Movement. Established in 1982, the JCC Maccabi(r) Games have brought together more than 150,000 teens and more than 500,000 host families, volunteers, and spectators for one\-week annual Olympic\-style events in host communities throughout North America. The program connects teens, JCCs, and communities from across North America and around the world to explore their Jewish identities, develop lasting memories, friendships, and connections, and make a difference in the Jewish world of today and of the future.


JCC Association of North America seeks an enthusiastic and dynamic professional to serve as Program Manager on the JCC Maccabi team. Reporting to the Program Director, this full\-time position provides high\-level administrative, operational, programmatic, and organizational support to the JCC Maccabi program.


Successful candidates are dedicated and competent professionals with strong verbal and written skills; are highly organized, detail\-oriented, hard\-working, and capable of tackling multiple projects at a time; and are comfortable in customer\- and stakeholder\-facing roles in addition to enjoying "back\-end" support, digital, and data management work. They work well independently but also thrive as committed members of a team in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment, while maintaining a high level of professionalism and integrity.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------


**Program Support**


*Support the JCC Maccabi program in ensuring strong, well\-resourced delegations and progress toward participation goals, including delivering high\-quality training and support for Delegation Heads and coaches, and helping build a positive, well\-organized experience for every JCC Maccabi delegation.*


Responsibilities include:


* Serve as a Delegation Head (DH) liaison, providing DHs across the field with monthly trainings and resources to support successful athlete recruitment and delegation management for the JCC Maccabi Games.
* Assist in designing, managing, and delivering DH and coach trainings, webinars, and supporting resources to help ensure the success of each JCC Maccabi delegation.
* Coordinate the Delegation Head Mentor/Mentee Program, connecting first\- and second\-year DHs with veteran DHs to guide them through recruitment and preparation for the JCC Maccabi Games.
* Support the Program Director in developing and stewarding organizational collaborations and partnerships.
* Under the direction of the Program Director, work to develop new programmatic initiatives (e.g., Jr. Maccabi, alumni engagement, year\-round teen programming, and partnerships).
* Develop and implement curriculum for the JCC Maccabi Teen International Leadership Board, made up of teenage JCC Maccabi athletes and alumni, to build leadership abilities, gather input on shaping the JCC Maccabi program, and develop skills in team collaboration, communication, and relationship building.
* Develop and deliver program surveys and support evaluation strategy and implementation.
* Assist in cross\-functional collaboration within JCC Association departments (e.g., program departments, marketing, finance, CRM implementation).
* With support from the Program Director, build a continental delegation (the J\-Team) when needed by recruiting or re\-engaging athletes, coaches, and volunteers, and play a lead role in all associated operational and programmatic efforts, including overseeing and managing logistics related to registration, travel, uniforms and swag, and sport\-specific positions.

**Administrative and Operational Support**

* Develop resources for the JCC Resource Center and Delegation Toolkit.
* Support the process of DH and coach training.
* Work with the Program Director to cultivate new strategies for efficient administration and program support.
* Manage program merchandising, including research, pricing, ordering, inventorying, and shipping program supplies.
* Assist with other duties as assigned.
* Provide on\-the\-ground support during the week(s) of JCC Maccabi to host communities, DHs, and the JCC Maccabi staff team.
* Interact and communicate with the host community, delegation heads and coaches, JCC Association team, parents, coaches, and athletes to help ensure a safe and positive experience for all participants.
* Oversee the smooth running of the J\-Team when needed


**At the Games**

* Provide on\-the\-ground support during the week(s) of JCC Maccabi to host communities, DHs, and the JCC Maccabi staff team.
* Interact and communicate with the host community, delegation heads and coaches, JCC Association team, parents, coaches, and athletes to help ensure a safe and positive experience for all participants.
* Oversee the smooth running of the J\-Team when needed

**Travel**


* Some travel anticipated throughout the year for site visits, Spring DH Meeting, and other JCC Association related events and gatherings as assigned.
* Travel to the host community for the week(s) of JCC Maccabi each summer (see "At the Games" above).
* Some periodic travel to New York headquarters (if a remote employee).

jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Analyst III
jobs.description:
CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier—physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it's at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.


CLEAR is seeking a Senior Security Operations Analyst III to join our SOC team to help strengthen our ability to detect, investigate, and respond to evolving security threats. In this role, you'll lead complex investigations, improve CLEAR's threat detection and response capabilities, and serve as a trusted security partner while helping develop the analysts and program around you.

  


***What you'll do:***


* Lead complex investigations of security events across corporate networks, endpoints, data centers, cloud environments, and other critical systems, driving incidents from initial analysis through escalation and remediation
* Develop, tune, and optimize threat detection logic across SIEM, EDR, and other security platforms, proactively identifying coverage gaps, reducing false positives, and improving the fidelity of security alerts
* Partner with Engineering, Infrastructure, and other teams to investigate threats, identify root causes, communicate risk, and drive timely remediation and improvements to CLEAR's security posture
* Apply threat intelligence, data, automation, and AI\-enabled tools to identify emerging attack patterns, accelerate investigations, improve detection workflows, and strengthen decision\-making while applying sound security judgment
* Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for other analysts, mentoring junior team members, sharing knowledge, and helping establish scalable processes, playbooks, and standards for threat detection and analysis
* Continuously evaluate CLEAR's detection coverage against the evolving threat landscape and frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK, identifying opportunities to improve visibility and proactively defend against emerging threats
* Lead improvements to Security Operations workflows, standard operating procedures, documentation, and tooling to increase the quality, consistency, and efficiency of threat analysis and incident response
* Clearly communicate technical findings, risk, and recommended actions to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, tailoring the level of detail to the audience
* Participate in the Security Operations on\-call rotation and respond to critical security events and incidents outside of standard working hours, as needed

  


***How you'll measure success:***


* High\-quality, accurate investigations that lead to timely containment, remediation, and actionable security improvements
* Measurable improvements in Security Operations workflows, detection logic, automation, and analyst efficiency
* Increased team capability through effective mentorship, knowledge sharing, documentation, and scalable operating practices
* Improved detection coverage, alert fidelity, and time to identify and respond to security threats

  


***What you're great at:***


* 8\+ years of cybersecurity experience, including 5\+ years in security operations, threat detection, incident response, or a related discipline
* Deep knowledge of SIEM, EDR, and security monitoring technologies, with demonstrated experience investigating complex events and developing, tuning, and optimizing detection logic
* Applying threat intelligence and frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK, NIST CSF, or ISO 27001 to identify adversary behavior, evaluate detection coverage, and strengthen security controls
* Using data, automation, scripting, and AI\-enabled security tools to improve threat detection and investigation workflows while applying strong analytical judgment to validate findings and make informed decisions
* Solving complex security problems independently, communicating findings clearly, building trusted cross\-functional relationships, and mentoring other analysts
* Certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, OSCP are a plus
* Experience working across teams and functions to deliver on strategic, program\-level goals

  


***How You'll be Rewarded:***



At CLEAR, we help YOU move forward \- because when you're at your best, we're at our best. You'll work with talented team members motivated by our mission of making experiences safer and easier. Our offices are bright and energetic with an open concept and plenty of conference rooms and casual co\-working spaces. We also offer catered lunches every day and have fully stocked kitchens. Outside of the office, we invest in your well\-being and learning \& development with stipends and reimbursement programs.



We offer holistic total rewards, including comprehensive healthcare plans, family\-building benefits (fertility and adoption/surrogacy support), flexible time off, annual wellness stipend, free OneMedical memberships for you and your dependents, a CLEAR Plus membership, and a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match. The base salary range for this role is $145,000 \- $170,000, depending on levels of skills and experience.



The base salary range represents the low and high end of CLEAR's salary range for this position. Salaries will vary depending on various factors which include, but are not limited to location, education, skills, experience and performance. The range listed is just one component of CLEAR's total compensation package for employees and other rewards may include annual bonuses, commission, Restricted Stock Units.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

The Office of Technology and Innovation (OTI) leverages technology to drive opportunity, improve public safety, and help government run better across New York City. From delivering affordable broadband to protecting against cybersecurity threats and building digital government services, OTI is at the forefront of how the city delivers for New Yorkers in the 21st century. Follow us on social media @NYCOfficeofTech, and visit www.nyc.gov/oti to learn more.  

  

At OTI, we offer great benefits, and the chance to work on projects that have a meaningful impact on millions of people. You'll have the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technology and collaborate with other passionate professionals who share your drive and commitment to making a difference through technology.  

  

About Cyber Command  

Cyber Command is charged with protecting all City systems against cyber threats, including systems that deliver vital services to New Yorkers. Headed by the Chief Information Security Officer of the City of New York, we provide in\-depth support to over 100 agencies and offices to protect, detect, identify, respond to, and recover from cyber threats.  

  

The Senior Threat Analyst position at NYC Cyber Command is mandated as part of a critical initiative due to the escalating cybersecurity threats faced by the city's infrastructure, public services, and sensitive data. In an era where cyberattacks are becoming increasingly sophisticated and prevalent, the role of a Senior Threat Analyst is paramount in fortifying the city's defenses, analyzing emerging threats, and developing proactive measures to mitigate potential risks.  

  

Responsibilities will include:  

* Perform many critical functions within the Threat Management discipline including staffing 24x7x365 coverage at the Citys Security Operations Center (SOC) augmenting FTE shift schedules including days, nights, weekends, and holidays.
* Interface with OTI Cyber Command teams internally, with City agencies, vendors, and information\-sharing partners.
* Monitor City networks and security alerts for intrusion, attempted compromise, and anomalous behavior;
* Apply mitigation techniques or escalation factors; correlate threat intelligence across various logs collected by established security controls.
* Produce routine SOC metrics \& reporting.
* Maintain situation reports (SITREPS) Perform weekly quality control checks.
* Work closely with SOC Director on incident preparation including the continuous development of new SOC playbooks and runbooks
* Handle special projects and initiatives as assigned.

Day \- Due to the necessary technical duties of this position in a 24/7 operation, candidate may be required to work various shifts such as weekends and/or nights/evenings.

* Communication and collaboration skills, executive presence.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


As a member of CSRM you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop industry leading programs that drive sustainable effectiveness.


As aProgram Manager in the EHS Solutions and Enablement Team, you will lead cross\-functional programs end\-to\-end translating high\-level strategic roadmaps into structured, measurable operational initiatives. You will manage multi\-disciplinary workstreams spanning global data center operations, environmental compliance, risk mitigation, and technology modernization. This role acts as a primary facilitator across the EHS business to ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within scope, and with high organizational adoption.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

jobs.description:

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in financial services, regulatory compliance, anti\-money laundering, transaction monitoring, or related domain.

jobs.title: Risk Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job title:** Risk Data Analyst**Reports to:** VP, Risk Management**Department:** Acquiring**Location:** Hicksville, NY**Grade:** 16 **About Priority Commerce:**
Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy\-to\-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue \- empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.  

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.  

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to ***be known for results*** \- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive. **About the Role:**
As a Risk Data Analyst, you will sit at the intersection of data science and financial risk, helping us identify, quantify, and mitigate risk across our merchant portfolio, payment channels, and partner ecosystem. You'll work closely with underwriting, compliance, fraud operations, and product teams to surface insights that protect the business and enable growth.


This is a high\-impact role for someone who is analytically rigorous, naturally curious, and comfortable translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

 **Responsibilities:*** Analyze transaction, merchant, and portfolio data to identify risk trends, anomalies, and emerging exposures across credit, fraud, and operational risk categories.
* Create recurring and ad hoc reports using SQL Server, Snowflake, Excel, Periscope, Tableau, and other business intelligence tools.
* Build and maintain dashboards, models, and reports that give risk stakeholders real\-time visibility into key risk indicators (KRIs), chargeback rates, merchant health scores, and portfolio concentration.
* Develop and refine recommendations for improvements in merchant underwriting, onboarding, and ongoing monitoring.
* Support chargeback and dispute analysis — identifying root causes, tracking trends by various dimensions (like MCC, processor, and/or partner), and recommending remediation strategies.
* Conduct portfolio segmentation analysis to identify high\-risk merchant segments and inform risk appetite decisions.
* Automate recurring risk reporting and data workflows to reduce manual effort and improve turnaround time.
* Collaborate with product, engineering and data teams to ensure risk data pipelines are accurate, complete, and timely.
* Assist in regulatory and audit\-related data requests, ensuring documentation is thorough and defensible.
* Stay current on payment industry risk trends, regulatory developments, and evolving fraud typologies.
* Ability to present data and findings to management.

 **What Success Looks Like:*** **Proactive Risk Detection**: Identify anomalous transactions, emerging fraud trends, and credit or operational exposures early through robust portfolio segmentation and risk data analysis.

**New York State Homes and Community Renewal (HCR)** is the State’s affordable housing agency, with a mission to build, preserve, and protect affordable housing and increase homeownership throughout New York State.

*This position is with HCR’s* ***State of New York Mortgage Agency (SONYMA)****. This is not a civil service position, and a civil service exam is not required. Candidates must meet the minimum qualifications outlined below to be considered.*


NYS Homes and Community Renewal (HCR) is committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility. Our work would not be possible without the diverse backgrounds, experiences, ideas, and abilities of our employees. HCR is committed to developing a workforce that represents the diverse population of New York State. HCR embraces a diverse and inclusive work environment by encouraging all individuals, including those with disabilities, to apply to open positions at the agency.


The **State of New York Mortgage Agency (SONYMA)** is one of several HCR agencies. SONYMA’s programs provide mortgage financing to assist low\- to moderate\-income, first\-time homebuyers in the purchase of a one\-to\-four unit residences that are required to meet eligibility criteria established by the Agency and by applicable Federal law. This position will report to the Single Family Programs unit of SONYMA. The Single Family unit reports to HCR’s Homeownership and Community Development.

**Position Summary:**


The Program Analyst is responsible for assisting the Single\-Family with quantitative and qualitative analysis, program development, and operational implementation. Serves as a key support to program leadership on single\-family loan portfolio performance, and bond transactions. This role also administers the Project Set\-Aside (PSA) Program to drive community development and developer\-driven affordable housing homeownership across New York State.

**Essential Duties / Responsibilities:**

* Act as the primary liaison between developers, participating lenders, and Agency operations staff to facilitate an efficient and seamless loan approval and mortgage purchase process.
* Establish and maintain a comprehensive database of approved projects and active developers. Track and monitor the delinquency and credit performance of mortgages originated within PSA communities.
* Assist with any special projects and other reasonable functions or duties as may be designated or assigned.

**Requirements/Qualifications:**


The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required for this position:

* Bachelor’s Degree \- Public Administration, Finance, Economics or other related field. Financial industry experience preferred, but not required.
* Ability to multitask and prioritize assignments.
* Superior quantitative research and verbal/written communication skills.
* Ability to communicate complex data insights in a clear and concise manner.
* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to data integrity and accuracy.
* Demonstrated research and numerical problem\-solving skills.
* Fluency in MS Office, particularly Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, VLookups and advanced formulas.

adMarketplace is the largest global marketplace for Native Search advertising. For over 25 years, we’ve connected brands with consumers at the moment they express commercial intent beyond legacy search engines.  

  

Today, our Native Search solutions are exclusively integrated across next\-generation platforms where discovery happens, including web browsers, Buy Now Pay Later apps, and AI chat surfaces. Powered by vector search technology, our platform delivers relevant text and product ads that match consumers with the brands, products, and offers they’re actively seeking.  

  

Our award\-winning culture is grounded in the principles of Curiosity, Collaboration, Creative Conflict, Commitment, and Competitiveness – our 5Cs. These values drive us to turn complexity into clarity and create measurable value for consumers, advertisers, and publishers alike.

##### **The Role**


We have an exciting opportunity for a Data Analyst to join our Finance team, dedicated to marketplace operations. The right person is passionate about connecting the dots between financial performance, day\-to\-day operational execution, and the underlying supply/demand dynamics that drive our marketplace. You'll sit inside Finance but work hands\-on with Operations (Demand Ops, Supply Ops, Campaign Management) and Pricing \& Yield, turning disparate operational and financial data into clear, actionable recommendations.


This role gives you a dedicated seat inside marketplace operations while reporting through Finance — visibility across the business that few analyst roles offer.

* Serve as the dedicated data analyst embedded in marketplace operations, working day\-to\-day with Demand Ops, Supply Ops, and Campaign Management while reporting through FP\&A.
* Analyze marketplace dynamics — supply/demand balance, pricing trends, yield, and competitive positioning — to surface insights that inform operational and revenue decisions.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and build reporting that improves day\-to\-day decision\-making across the teams you support.
* Build and maintain models and dashboards that unify financial and operational data, reducing manual reporting effort over time.
* Translate complex, cross\-functional analysis into clear recommendations for senior leadership, including financial impact, tradeoffs, and risk.
* Support scenario planning and variance analysis tying operational drivers to financial outcomes.

* Experience developing forecasting or analytical models and evaluating their performance over time.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, advanced formulas, lookups, etc.).

* Experience building dashboards using Tableau, Sigma, Power BI, or similar BI platforms.

* Strong analytical thinking, business judgment, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment while maintaining a high level of attention to detail.

About the Opportunity

Shield Analysis Technology, LLC is seeking an experienced Program Manager to join our proposed team supporting the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) BioPreferred Program. This is an opportunity to lead a multidisciplinary team supporting a Federal program that promotes the purchase and use of biobased products.

We are looking for a collaborative leader who can bring structure to complex work, build strong relationships with Government stakeholders, support a diverse technical team, and keep performance aligned with contract requirements.

The position will be hybrid, with travel anticipated two to three times per year depending on the selected candidate’s location. The anticipated start date is 9/30/2026, schedule, and level of effort will be confirmed following contract award.

As the Program Manager, you will serve as Shield’s primary leader and point of accountability for the anticipated USDA BioPreferred Program support contract. You will guide planning, staffing, performance, quality, financial management, and communication across the contract.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Lead the overall planning and execution of the anticipated USDA BioPreferred Program support contract.
* Serve as Shield’s primary point of contact for the Contracting Officer and Contracting Officer’s Representative.
* Develop and maintain program plans, schedules, staffing assignments, workflows, budgets, performance measures, and reporting procedures.
* Translate contract requirements into clear assignments, milestones, deliverables, and acceptance criteria.

* Coordinate analytical studies, cost\-benefit analyses, technical assessments, program evaluations, and performance\-measurement activities.

* Strategic planning
* Project or program management
* Information technology
* Program evaluation
* Contract management
* Financial management
* At least five years of experience supporting Federal agencies in areas related to:

* Federal policy

* Information technology
