jobs.description:
**This Opportunity**
--------------------

The Power Delivery Project Manager (PDPM) will manage Distribution resiliency projects throughout Louisiana, with the ability to work remotely or hybrid from any mutually acceptable location in the region. This role will be performed as part of a larger program team. You must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face to face meetings. Tasks include providing technical project supervision and guidance in managing the administrative, commercial, and technical components of electric utility, power distribution, and power delivery infrastructure projects in alignment with WSP’s core values and contractual commitments. The PDPM will be responsible for overall performance of distribution resiliency work. Oversight includes financial performance, technical execution, client satisfaction, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC), safety, and schedule adherence.  



  

Ensures that responsibilities throughout the full project lifecycle (feasibility, engineering design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout) are executed in compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements (e.g., NERC, IEEE, NEC), and utility industry best practices.


As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world\-class expertise in power delivery and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure\-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition. And we need your help.


**Your Impact**
---------------

* Lead and oversee cross\-functional teams delivering power distribution, substation, and utility engineering projects, ensuring execution of design and construction deliverables.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects involving distribution lines, feeders, substations, and grid infrastructure upgrades, including budgets, schedule, cost control, and resource allocation.
* Develop and manage project scopes, cost estimates, schedules, and resource plans for utility capital improvement programs and transmission \& distribution (T\&D) projects.
* Build and maintain Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) aligned with engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) project delivery models.
* Ensure compliance with utility standards, environmental regulations, permitting requirements, and safety protocols (OSHA, utility HSE standards).
* Participate in proposal development, RFP responses, and business development efforts within the power \& energy market.
* Perform margin analysis, risk assessments, and contingency planning for large\-scale power delivery projects.
* Coordinate contract negotiations, client presentations, and stakeholder meetings with utilities, municipalities, and regulatory agencies.
* Develop and maintain project plans including PMP, Safety Plans, Risk Management Plans, and QA/QC procedures.
* Collaborate with engineering teams specializing in distribution design, protection \& controls, relay systems, and grid automation.
* Partner with Project Accounting to manage financials including forecasting, earned value management (EVM), and profitability tracking.
* Lead efforts in change management, scope control, and claims mitigation.
* Coordinate with technical managers on staffing for overhead and underground distribution projects, substations, and renewable interconnections.
* Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards, escalating issues when necessary.
* Provide reporting to clients and leadership on project performance, risks, schedule, and budget status.
* Manage project closeout activities, including lessons learned and continuous improvement for future T\&D projects.
* Stay current on power industry trends, grid resilience, distributed energy resources (DER), and electrification initiatives.
* Exercise responsible and ethical decision\-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
* Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

**Who You Are**
---------------

**Required Qualifications** 

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or related field.
* 10\+ years of relevant post education experience. Preferred in a project management role within the Power Delivery/Utility Industry or design experience with Overhead Distribution, Transmission, or Substation assets.
* Strong understanding of utility operations, power systems engineering, and electrical distribution design.
* Familiarity with NERC, IEEE standards, NEC codes, and utility regulatory requirements.
* Experience with EPC project delivery, capital programs, and infrastructure projects within the energy sector.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills in complex utility environments.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills working with utilities, clients, regulators, and internal engineering teams.
* Experience with project management tools (MS Project, Primavera P6\), financial tracking, and reporting systems.
* Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams including engineering, design, procurement, and construction professionals.
Knowledge of QA/QC processes, risk management, and safety compliance in utility projects.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional Engineer (PE) license.
* PMI Certification (PMP).

Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

jobs.description:
***SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.***

**Job Description Summary:**


The Assistant Commissioning Manager supports the planning, execution, and oversight of testing and commissioning activities for SOLV Energy’s High‑Voltage (HV), Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), and Photovoltaic (PV) projects. In this role, you will work closely with the Commissioning Manager and technical subject‑matter experts to ensure all systems and components are installed, tested, and commissioned in accordance with project requirements, safety standards, and industry best practices. The Assistant Commissioning Manager helps manage project‑level commissioning teams and coordinates with cross‑functional stakeholders to ensure a seamless transition from commissioning through project closeout. This position plays a key role in delivering high‑quality, reliable, and fully operable renewable energy assets.
  

  

This role is hybrid, with onsite presence required at job sites and partial remote work. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.**Job Description:**

* *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned*

**Position Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Manage the project commissioning team, providing guidance, training, and support to ensure efficient and effective execution of tasks.
* Report daily to the Commissioning Manager, the status of each project assigned.
* Review technical, contractual, and regulatory requirements related to commissioning and assist with the development of a project milestone and deliverables list, project specific commissioning plan, and commissioning procedures.
* Communicate with the OEM suppliers regarding equipment specific testing and commissioning activities.
* Coordinate with project teams, including engineering, construction, and quality assurance, to ensure alignment in all commissioning activities.
* Assist with the development of integrated P6 testing and commissioning schedules. Ensure that the integrated testing and commissioning schedule is updated weekly
* Assist with the development of the commissioning resource plan for the project.
* Review initial energization procedures and assist Commissioning Engineer with switching activities as requested. Perform subsequent switching activities of the MVAC collection circuits and Aux Power circuits as required during facility Hot Commissioning. Develop switching plans and LOTO as required.
* Identify, analyze, and recommend corrective actions to resolve technical issues identified during commissioning or initial operation.
* Support the development of standards and processes to improve business.
* Manage all pre\-commissioning, cold, warm, and hot commissioning tests, including synchronization, functional testing, utility capability testing, and project acceptance testing for all BESS, HV or PV plant systems.
* Ensure all commissioning activities comply with industry standards, safety protocols, and environmental regulations.
* Prepare detailed daily commissioning reports, review test results, issues encountered, and corrective actions taken.
* Monitor project timelines and resources to ensure successful project delivery.
* Continuously improve commissioning processes by incorporating feedback and lessons learned from completed projects.
* Prepare and maintain Lessons Learned and equipment warranty tracking logs.
* Establish and manage: Safety Tagging, Lockout, Red Rope, and Work Permit Programs ensuring site compliance with all provisions upon the start of cold commissioning activities throughout project Substantial Completion.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

* Knowledge and commissioning of Utility scale solar, battery storage, and high voltage substations.
* Knowledge and experience with HV and MV switching operations, and equipment grounding.
* Knowledge and experience with the management and application of site lock\-out / tag\-out (LOTO) safety program procedures.
* Knowledge and experience with substation protection and control (P\&C) systems.
* Knowledge of Fiber installation and test requirements.
* SCADA system understanding, testing, and commissioning requirements.
* DC systems architecture and testing requirements.
* Knowledgeable in National Fire Protection Association/National Electrical Code (NFPA/NEC) standards, and IEEE/IES/API Standards.
* NETA and IEEE standards related to utility scale solar generation, i.e. Transformers, MV and LV cabling, grounding, and solar specific component testing.
* Understands the commercial performance of power plants.
* A working knowledge of NERC compliance standards along with ISO and TSO testing and operational requirements is highly beneficial.
* Familiarity with DCS / SCADA control systems and methods for utility scale generation a plus.
* Knowledge of microprocessor protective relay testing is a plus.
* Functional competencies include attention to detail, communication, customer focus, prioritization, and drive.


Safety

* Leads by example show that safety is the most important function, ensuring that all employees follow safe practices while working.
* Responsible for consistently reinforcing safe work practices and addressing at‑risk behaviors promptly and effectively.
* Adheres to and ensures all site team members understand standard operating procedures.
* Leads and supports the site team in technical, quality and safety, utilizing system in place.

-----------


This position is located in the Architect of the Capitol (AOC), Office of the Chief Security Officer (OCSO), Deputy Operations, Security Infrastructure Projects Division. The Architect/Engineer (Planning and Program Manager) is responsible for project management development, with emphasis on projects involving security infrastructure or facilities.


Learn more about this agency


  
**This job is open to**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

The General Engineer/Architect develops a life cycle implementation plan, rough order magnitude budget and timeline for each project with all facilities and infrastructure as assigned by the Deputies and/or the Chief Security Officer. * Prepares and updates all program and project funding documentation for all funding sources.
* Provides assistance to the Assistant Director, Security Infrastructure Projects Division in coordinating with AOC staff and officials of affected jurisdictions to keep them informed on project planning. * Provides assistance to the Assistant Director, Security Infrastructure Projects Division over use of resources and efforts related to the implementation of projects; and exercises specified contracting officer authority for execution and administration of personal and professional services contracts.

Also, must have a working knowledge of ADA accessibility standards to ensure compliance with these requirements; shall initiate or take corrective action to ensure compliance with these codes and standards.

Performs other related duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Financial and Operations Analyst (TS/SCI #26-151)
jobs.description:
Strategic Analysis is seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented Financial \& Operations Analyst to provide dedicated program\-level financial execution support to a Government Program Manager (PM). In this role, you will be part of the program office's primary financial execution team \-translating PM budget allocations, spend plans, and programmatic milestones into timely, compliant, and auditable financial transactions. The ideal candidate possesses deep, hands\-on experience executing financial vehicles across the full funding lifecycle, including preparing and routing Purchase Requests (PRs), Military Interdepartmental Purchase Requests (MIPRs \- DD Form 448/448\-2\), and Interagency Agreements (FS Form 7600A/7600B) via Treasury's G\-Invoicing platform. You will serve as the financial bridge between the Program Office, servicing contracting activities, performing organizations (e.g., National Labs, FFRDCs, DoD test ranges), and external agency partners to ensure maximum obligation efficiency and compliance with DoD Financial Management Regulations (DoD FMR).

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* Execute day\-to\-day funding and procurement documentation based on PM guidance and approved budget execution plans, including Purchase Requisitions (PRs), MIPRs (Direct Cite and Reimbursable), and Interagency Agreements (IAAs).
* Lead the drafting, package coordination, routing, and tracking of FS Form 7600A (General Terms \& Conditions) and FS Form 7600B (Order Requirements and Funding Information) through the Department of the Treasury's G\-Invoicing portal.
* Manage the end\-to\-end processing of DD Form 448 (MIPR) and coordinate with performing/servicing agencies to obtain and record accepted DD Form 448\-2 (Acceptance of MIPR) in a timely manner.
* Assemble comprehensive, audit\-ready funding packages with all necessary supporting artifacts (e.g., SOW/PWS, Independent Government Cost Estimates \[IGCE], justification and authorization \[J\&A], determinations and findings \[D\&F]).
* Serve as the frontline interface with Contracting Officers (KOs), Contracting Officer Representatives (CORs), and external performing agencies to resolve administrative and funding bottlenecks.
* Track commitments, obligations, expenses, and disbursements (COED) against approved spend plans across multiple fiscal years, colors of money (RDT\&E, O\&M, Procurement), and funding appropriations.
* Monitor program execution benchmarks (e.g., OSD obligation and expenditure goals) to identify potential funding withholdings, decrements, or under\-execution risks; formulate actionable recovery strategies for the PM.
* Track contract funding burn rates, invoice status, and unliquidated obligations (ULOs); lead monthly invoice reviews and de\-obligation actions for excess funds.
* Coordinate and support Triannual Reviews (TAR) to validate open commitments and unliquidated obligations, ensuring strict adherence to the Financial Improvement and Audit Remediation (FIAR) standards.
* Input, track, and reconcile financial transactions within government enterprise resource planning (ERP) and financial accounting systems (e.g., DAI, GFEBS, DEAMS, or agency\-specific equivalents).
* Monitor buy/sell activity, intragovernmental performance transactions, and financial clearinghouse workflows inside G\-Invoicing, resolving billing and receipt discrepancies with buyer/seller partners.
* Maintain consolidated program office budget trackers, ledgers, and contract register databases in Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, or internal program tools.
* Generate recurring and ad\-hoc financial execution reports, burn\-rate charts, and executive dashboards for the PM, Deputy PM, and division leadership.
* Support mid\-year reviews, Program Objective Memorandum (POM) inputs, end\-of\-fiscal\-year (EOY) execution sprints, and urgent leadership financial drills.
* Participate in program status meetings, acquisition milestone reviews, and integrated baseline reviews (IBRs) to provide real\-time budget and funding status.


  

**Required Qualifications:*** Clearance: Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility and an active Counterintelligence (CI) Polygraph (or ability to pass a CI Polygraph prior to onboarding).
* Education \& Experience:
* Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Acquisition Management, Economics, or a related discipline.
* 5\-7 years of direct experience in DoD or Intelligence Community (IC) budget execution, program financial management, or financial SETA/A\&AS support. (Equivalent combination of specialized experience and military/DoD financial management may substitute).
* Specialized Financial Execution Expertise:
* Demonstrated, hands\-on experience preparing, tracking, and processing Purchase Requests (PRs) and Military Interdepartmental Purchase Requests (MIPRs / DD Form 448 \& 448\-2\).
* Direct experience with Interagency Agreements (IAAs) using FS Form 7600A and FS Form 7600B.
* Working knowledge and proficiency with the Treasury's G\-Invoicing platform for intragovernmental buy/sell transactions.
* Knowledge of Regulations \& Policies:
* Solid understanding of the DoD Financial Management Regulation (DoD FMR 7000\.14\-R), FAR/DFARS fiscal principles, Antideficiency Act (ADA), Purpose Statute, and Bona Fide Needs Rule.
* Familiarity with different appropriations/colors of money (RDT\&E, Procurement, O\&M) and their respective statutory life cycles and obligation/expenditure thresholds.
* Technical Skills:
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, nested formulas, financial modeling, dynamic charts).
* Working knowledge of government financial/acquisition platforms (e.g., DAI, GFEBS, DEAMS, PRISM, WAWF/PIEE, or equivalent IC/DoD tools)

jobs.title: Site Security Manager
jobs.description:
**Site Security Manager**  

**Wage:** $105,000\-$115,000/ annually

 **4\-5 years of data center security experience**

**5\-6 years in security operations management**

 **The Site Security Manager (SSM)** leads a team of site security personnel, including site managers, field training officers, and security officers, and is accountable for delivering physical security\-related services at one or more assigned locations within a geographic area. The SSM is responsible for the leadership development of the individuals who report to them, while also being accountable for the delivery of security operations at these locations. The SSM partners with senior leadership and management teams in Security and Operations to drive operational effectiveness, superior performance, and audit readiness.

**Position Overview:**  

The Site Security Manager (SSM) leads a team of site security personnel, including site managers, field training officers, and security officers, and is accountable for delivering physical security\-related services at one or more assigned locations within a geographic area. The SSM is responsible for the leadership development of the individuals who report to them, while also being accountable for the delivery of security operations at these locations. The SSM partners with senior leadership and management teams in Security and Operations to drive operational effectiveness, superior performance, and audit readiness. Responsible for preserving an environment where people and property are safe and well\-protected, the SSM utilizes their professional experience to manage individuals with varying skill sets and develops effective strategies to drive improvement. The SSM reports directly to the regional security manager, works alongside other site security managers in their metro area, and manages the Security Team Manager (STM).

**Essential Functions:**

* Manages physical security operations at multiple critical infrastructure facilities.
* Drives safety programming for the security team with a goal of zero workplace injuries onsite.
* Actively manages site security personnel; partners with the local branch to recruit and hire, oversee onboarding, training, and development at the sites.
* Ensures each staff member is treated with dignity and respect.
* Plans, assigns, and manages physical security projects and tasks to timely completion.
* Coaches security employees and carries out disciplinary actions in accordance with current policy.
* Evaluates the effectiveness of site security operations and provides recommendations for improvement.
* Utilizes excellent customer service and communication skills, sets the example, and holds site security staff accountable to do the same.
* Ensures site health and key performance indicator goals are met or exceeded; works with the regional security manager (RSM) to enhance security team effectiveness and performance.
* Meets regularly with the client and Securitas corporate management representatives for account reviews, addresses issues in a timely manner, and supports security planning, assessments, and surveys.
* Keeps management informed of major accomplishments, issues, and concerns.
* Follows standardized procedures to successfully complete unannounced audits.
* Builds and maintains relationships with internal and external stakeholders to maintain a safe and secure environment.
* Splits time equally between sites, building familiarity with each location, leading the team, building the program, and coaching for success.

 **Additional Information:**

* The functions listed describe the business purpose of this job. Specific duties or tasks may vary and be documented separately. The employee might not be required to perform all functions listed. Additional duties may be assigned, and functions may be modified according to business necessity.
* All assigned duties or tasks are deemed to be part of the essential functions unless such duties or tasks are unrelated to the functions listed, in which case they are deemed to be other (non\-essential) functions.
* Employees are held accountable for successful job performance.

 **See a different world.**


Securitas is committed to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic.

  

Our Company Mission:
Securitas’ mission is to protect homes, workplaces, and communities by providing the security services they need to protect their assets, safeguard their people, and maintain their ability to generate profits.  

  

Our Values:
Securitas’ core values \- Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness \- are the foundation for our employees to build trust with customers, colleagues, and the surrounding community.  

  

Integrity:
Securitas employees are honest and trusted by customers to safeguard their premises and valuables. We don’t compromise on integrity and create an open forum for our employees and customers to voice opinions, report improprieties, and share information.  

  

Vigilance:
Seeing, hearing, and evaluating. A Securitas employee is always attentive and often notices things that others don’t. Their vigilance is necessary in order to be aware of potential risks or incidents that may take place on our customers’ premises.  

  

Helpfulness:
As part of an on\-going effort to ensure safety, Securitas employees are always ready to help if an incident occurs that requires intervention regardless of whether or not it is directly related to their job.
Securitas employees come from all walks of life, bringing with them a variety of distinctive skills and perspectives. United through our common purpose, we provide the security needed to safeguard our clients' assets and people. Our core values \- Integrity, Vigil

jobs.description:

============

When you join AIS, you’re joining a mission\-driven team that’s passionate about making a difference. You’ll work on projects that matter, alongside industry\-leading experts, in an environment that fosters innovation, driving client success, and empowering our team to make a lasting impact. As an employee\-owned company, we value collaboration, inclusivity, continuous growth, and shared success.


* **Employee Ownership** : Your contributions directly impact the company’s success, and you share in its achievements.
* **Continuous Learning** : Access to resources, training, and mentorship to support your professional growth.
* **Inclusive Culture** : A workplace where diversity is celebrated, and everyone’s voice is valued.
* **Mission\-Driven Work** : Engage in projects that make a meaningful difference for our clients and communities.

**What are we looking for?**
============================

At AIS, we're looking for more than just skills \- we're looking for driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference, eager to grow, and aligned with our core principles.

===========================

* Maintain alignment among activity, contractual deliverables, customer adoption, and intended business outcomes.
* Identify execution drift early and drive corrective decisions.

* Improve recurring checklists, templates, playbooks, and operating procedures.

jobs.title: Senior Proposal & Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**  

Precision Collective delivers innovative professional services and strategic consulting solutions to federal agencies helping accomplish complex missions with precision, purpose, and exceptional client service. We provide program management, strategic communications, technical consulting, and administrative support services delivering meaningful results. Explore opportunities to join our team at https://precisioncollective.com/careers/  

  

**Why Work at Precision Collective?**  

At Precision Collective, we believe great organizations are built by great people. We invest in talented professionals who are curious, collaborative, and committed to delivering exceptional results. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to work alongside experienced leaders, contribute to meaningful federal missions, and grow your career in an environment that values innovation, accountability, and continuous development.  

  

**Position Description**  

Precision Collective is seeking a Senior Proposal \& Business Ops Manager to join our leadership team and play a critical role in the continued growth of the company. This is not a traditional proposal\-management position. We are looking for a mid\-career DoW, CBRN, CWMD, or national security professional federal procurements, can write and manage winning proposals, and is equally comfortable solving operational and organizational challenges.  

  

The successful candidate will become a trusted partner to the Executive Director of Ops with meaningful ownership across three critical areas of the business: Proposal Leadership \& Business Development, Corporate Operations, and Personnel \& Workforce Management. This role is ideal for someone who has spent several years in the defense contracting or military environment and is ready for a position where writing ability, judgment, initiative, mission knowledge, and leadership directly influence company growth and success.  

A qualified candidate will perform the following duties and responsibilities, but are not limited to:


* Lead federal proposals from solicitation release through final submission, including analysis of RFPs, RFQs, RFIs, PWSs, SOWs, and evaluation criteria.
* Write, edit, and refine high\-quality proposal content, including technical, management, staffing, past performance, and corporate experience sections.
* Develop proposal strategies, compliance matrices, outlines, schedules, storyboards, and production plans.
* Collaborate across Finance, HR, Business Development, Contracts, and Operations to resolve issues and improve organizational effectiveness.
* All other duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree and relevant professional experience; equivalent military or professional experience may be considered.
* Demonstrated experience developing, writing, and/or managing federal government proposals.
* Experience supporting executive\-level operations or corporate functions in a government contracting environment.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, and SharePoint).
* U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security.

**Security Clearance Requirements**  

Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance. U.S. Citizenship required.  

  

**Location \& Travel**  

This is a full\-time position based in Falls Church, VA, with minimal travel expected.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Shipley Proposal Process certification or equivalent formal proposal training.

**Total Rewards**  

At Precision Collective, we believe our people are the foundation of our success. We are committed to providing competitive compensation, meaningful career development opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package that supports your health, financial well\-being, and work\-life balance. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability coverage, a 401(k)\-retirement plan with company match, paid time off, paid holidays, professional development opportunities, and employee wellness resources. Eligible employees may also participate in additional company\-sponsored programs and benefits. As a growing organization, we foster a collaborative, innovative, and mission\-focused culture where employees are empowered to contribute, grow professionally, and make a meaningful impact in support of our federal customers.  

  

Compensation at Precision Collective is determined based on a variety of job\-related factors, including education, relevant experience, certifications, knowledge, skills, competencies, internal equity, external market conditions, geographic location, security clearance level, contract labor category and funding requirements, organizational needs, and applicable federal, state, and local laws. The projected salary range for this position reflects full\-time employment. Actual starting compensation will be based on the selected candidate’s qualifications and the factors identified above. Compensation for part\-time positions will be adjusted proportionately based on scheduled hours worked.  

  

**Posted Salary Range** USD $115,500 \- $150,000 / Yr.

jobs.title: Program Analyst, Senior (E-6B, Mission Systems Architecture) (PMA 271)
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Program Analyst, Senior (E\-6B, Mission Systems Architecture) (PMA 271\)


**Requisition \#:** 300

**Work Environment:** On Site


**Position Type:** Exempt


**Salary Range:** $95,000 — $140,000 ***\*\*\*This is an estimated salary range. Compensation will be*** ***commensurate*** ***with experience\*\*\****

**Location:** Patuxent River, MD


**Clearance Level Required:** Secret

**Davis Defense Group, Inc.** has secured a stellar reputation as one of the premier Women\-Owned Small Business (WOSB) in the aerospace and defense industry, steadfastly supporting the Department of Defense since 2002\. A critical combination of vision and dedication to excellence has helped our customers achieve numerous significant milestones on schedule and within budget. Today we employ over 700 personnel around the globe in a mix of analytical, advisory, technical, and support positions. The common thread across our organization is our commitment to our customers and an unwavering dedication to our principle motto: “Mission Focused, Future Ready. Innovating today, Leading tomorrow.”


**Functional Description:**

* Applies analytic techniques in the evaluation of program/project objectives.
* Analyzes requirements, status, budget and schedules.
* Performs management, technical, or business case analyses.
* Collects, completes, organizes and interprets data relating to aircraft/weapon/project acquisition and product programs.
* Tracks program/project status and schedules.
* Applies government\-instituted processes for documentation, change control management and data management.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**


As a Sr. Program Analyst, you are responsible for providing senior staff recommendations for E\-6B related initiatives. Responsibilities include providing sustainment, acquisition, and financial expertise for the E\-6B Mercury strategic airborne command post aircraft supporting the MSA IPTL. Tasking includes creating, managing, and reporting procurement, financial, and contractual performance of assigned E\-6B Mission Systems Architecture and related projects. The position would be responsible directly to IPTs within MSA in tracking of readiness and sustainment requirements for current fleet need/demand as well as tracking and developing future requirements that impact mission systems. Apply knowledge and expertise in continuous process improvement environment to track performance to plan aligned with program office efforts.


* Provide sustainment, acquisition, and financial support for initiatives in support of the E\-6B Mission Systems Architecture IPT.
* Facilitate and manage spend plans using CSPT, PID planning, align SPID entries with the IPT strategy and contract execution, and respond to and develop program data calls.
* Support input and update to the RMT.
* Track and analyze budget planning, execution data, and schedule execution data to provide actionable inputs and recommendations to the Integrated Product Team Lead (IPTL).
* Liaise directly with program office Contract Specialists and Procurement Contracting Officer in the development and processing of SOW, SOO, Performance Work Statements (PWS), Performance Based Specifications, CDRLs, Technical Evaluations, and other contractual documentation for contracting efforts.
* Manage procurements using PMT, including development and management of PID; coordination and preparation of all actions required for conducting Procurement Planning Conferences (PPC’s); generation, routing, and tracking of Procurement Planning Agreements (PPAs); and input, tracking, and reporting of PMT actions and milestones.
* Enter and maintain IPT cost, schedule and performance data in AcqMat; analyze and interpret APHM dashboard data.
* Apply NAVAIR and OSD instructions for acquisition planning, procurement execution, data requirements, program reviews, budget development and coordination, and program planning.
* Participate in status briefs and recommend responses to program inquiries.
* Serves as Program Analyst lead for managing, tracking and reporting procurement status and activities.
* Support the operation of the IPT including scheduling and organizing meetings, making data calls and assessing the data, updating schedules, and supporting development of procurement packages.
* Track program/project status and schedules.
* Develop and coordinate program documentation, requirements documents, and program and budget/funding resource plans.
* Support acquisition strategy development, prepare for program reviews, and review and recommend alternative strategies to reduce program risk.

**Required Experience**:


Minimum of 10 years of combined experience performing duties described in the functional description with at least 3 of those years analyzing budgets.

**Desired Experience**:


* At least 3 years of experience developing and coordinating procurement documentation. Experience with acquisition reviews and cost analysis.
* Experience with the following: Common Spend Plan Tool (CSPT), Program Management Tool (PMT), Contract Data Requirements Lists (CDRLS), Program, Planning and Budgeting System (PPBS), Statements of Work (SOW), Procurement Initiation Documents (PID), and AcqMat/APHM.
* Knowledge of aircraft mission systems and the modification of those systems for in\-service aircraft.
* Experience working with OEMs, preparing J\&As and developing and editing SOO/SOWs.
* An understanding of the risk management process and the ability to assist with the preparation or review of CDRLs.
* Familiarity with the engineering change process is a plus.
* Proficiency in MS tools, PowerPoint, Excel, TEAMS, and MS Project.
* Ability to create pivot tables and graphs of data from exports of CSPT and other sources.

**Education Requirements****:**


MA/MS degree or supplemental experience is required.


When we review candidates' information, we are looking for the best matches for the position based on the qualifications listed in the job posting.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Program Manager
jobs.description:
### **Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

*This role is based at our corporate office in McLean, VA*

The Senior Strategic Program Manager plays a pivotal role in enabling Hilton's Marketing \& Loyalty organization to operationalize high priority strategies into coordinated, measurable business outcomes. This role leads complex strategic programs that may include new launches, enterprise partnerships, Hilton Honors experiences, global marketing initiatives, and other business\-critical priorities.


Reporting to the Director, Global Marketing Strategy, Operations \& Program Management, this role operates with broad influence, partnering closely with executive sponsors and leaders across Hilton's Marketing \& Loyalty organization and the broader enterprise. In a highly matrixed global environment spanning functional teams, business units, trading brands, regions, and external partners, this role serves as a senior integrator from program definition through launch, stabilization, and transition. The Senior Strategic Program Manager brings structure to ambiguity, aligns stakeholders around shared outcomes and decisions, and establishes the governance and execution discipline required to deliver with speed, quality, and accountability.


**What you'll do during a typical day:**

* Lead the end\-to\-end orchestration of complex, high\-priority programs across Marketing \& Loyalty and the broader enterprise, including new brand launches, strategic partnerships, Hilton Honors experiences, cross\-regional initiatives, and other enterprise priorities.
* Translate business strategy and leadership direction into clear program charters, objectives, scope, success measures, integrated roadmaps, and executable workplans.
* Act as a senior integrator across brand, marketing, loyalty, partnerships, regional marketing, commercial, digital, creative, media, analytics, technology, finance and external partners.
* Establish effective program governance, including roles and responsibilities, decision rights, workstream accountabilities, milestone plans, operating cadences, and escalation paths.
* Manage critical paths, cross\-workstream dependencies, resources, risks, issues, changes, and trade\-offs; surface implications early and drive resolution.
* Lead cross\-functional working sessions, leadership reviews, steering committees, and launch\-readiness forums that convert discussion into clear decisions, owners, and actions.
* Balance enterprise objectives and standards with brand, regional, market, and partner needs, ensuring coordinated sequencing, localization, adoption, and execution readiness.
* Identify systemic gaps in ways of working and lead improvements to program management processes, operating models, playbooks, tools, and collaboration practices.

**How you'll collaborate with others:**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to executive sponsors and senior leaders, providing concise, decision\-oriented communication on program health, risks, trade\-offs, options, and recommendations.
* Build alignment and shared accountability across diverse teams and influence outcomes without direct authority.
* Facilitate high priority and ambiguous conversations with experience to move teams from complexity to clarity.
* Partner with functional, brand, regional, business, and external partner leaders to ensure plans are integrated, commitments are realistic, and operational plans can be adopted and sustained.

**Projects you'll take ownership of:**

* A varied portfolio of strategic programs spanning key enterprise priorities. Program framing and mobilization, including charters, stakeholder maps, governance models, workstream structures, success measures, and responsibility matrices.
* Integrated program roadmaps and detailed plans, including milestones, dependencies, critical paths, resource assumptions, risk and issue logs, decision logs, and change control.
* Weekly, monthly, and quarterly program updates, executive briefings, steering committee materials, and decision papers tailored to different levels of the organization.
* Cross\-functional kickoffs, operating cadences, workstream reviews, leadership forums, and escalation mechanisms that maintain momentum and accountability.
* Launch and implementation readiness, including integrated readiness plans, testing and validation, contingency planning, stakeholder communications, and transition to business owners.
* Post\-launch stabilization and program closeout, including outcome measurement, lessons learned, benefit realization, knowledge transfer, and reusable playbooks.
* Adoption of AI\-enabled tools and modern program management methodologies to improve planning, synthesis, risk identification, decision support, and operational effectiveness.

### **What It Takes to Make the Stay**

**You have these minimum qualifications:**

* Seven (7\) years of professional experience in strategic program management, business operations, strategy, consulting, marketing, loyalty, or a related discipline.
* Four (4\) years of experience leading complex, cross\-functional programs from strategy through implementation in a large, global, matrixed organization.
* Demonstrated expertise translating strategy into structured execution and measurable outcomes, with strong command of scope, schedule, governance, risk, issue, decision, and change management.
* Experience synthesizing complex information into concise updates, decision points, trade\-offs, and recommendations.
* Exceptional stakeholder leadership and influence across functions, brands, regions, partners, and organizational levels.
* Broad business and marketing acumen, with working knowledge of brand, loyalty and customer experience, partnerships, digital, media, analytics, technology, commercial functions, and regional activation.
* Travel up to 5%.

**It would be useful if you have:**

* Experience in hospitality, travel, consumer services, loyalty programs, new brand launches, or strategic partnerships.
*

jobs.title: Principal, Technical Program Manager, Secure Connection Services (SCS), Tactical Edge Mission Engineering Group (TEMEG)
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Shape the future of secure communications for the world's most critical missions. As a Principal Technical Program Manager for SCS TEMEG, you'll define the strategy and lead customers and cross\-functional teams to solve problems of high ambiguity and high impact.  

  

Secure Connections Services (SCS), Tactical Edge Mission Engineering Group (TEMEG) designs, develops, and delivers emerging edge capabilities to enable the use of AWS services.  

  

You own the strategic roadmap and drive cross\-organizational alignment on priorities and delivery. You leverage deep technical expertise and executive\-level stakeholder management to deliver solutions from concept through customer adoption. You bring proven experience architecting large\-scale distributed systems and apply that expertise to commercial and government customers. You are data\- and metric\-driven, and relentlessly focused on performance in resource\-constrained environments.  

  

* Solve challenging problems that will revolutionize satellite connectivity in the cloud
* Work for a recognized leader in supporting space customers with cloud computing
* Have direct impact on hundreds, possibly thousands, of users of the AWS secure connections ecosystem.

  

If you're driven to lead at the intersection of security innovation and mission\-critical impact, this is the role for you.  

  

If Arlington, VA (Arlington HQ2\):  

  

This role will sit in our new headquarters in Northern Virginia, where Amazon will invest $2\.5 billion dollars, occupy 4 million square feet of energy efficient office space, and create at least 25,000 new full\-time jobs. Our employees and the neighboring community will also benefit from the associated investments from the Commonwealth including infrastructure updates, public transportation improvements, and new access to Reagan National Airport.  

  

By working together on behalf of our customers, we are building the future one innovative product, service, and idea at a time. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.  

  

This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

In this role you will:  

  

* Serve as the primary executive interface with customers, translating mission\-critical requirements into product roadmap priorities for engineering teams
* Drive cross\-organizational alignment across product, engineering, sales, and partner teams to deliver integrated solutions
* Work across the product, program, engineering, hardware, software, and infrastructure teams to manage requirements, scope, and delivery of worldwide AWS security features and services
* Assess risks, anticipate issues, overcome technical obstacles, and make difficult trade\-off decisions while managing cost and schedule to drive adoption goals and meet our customer commitments.

  

Successful candidates will have a strong technical background, be detail oriented, and have excellent problem\-solving abilities. You will represent program status to senior leadership. Your program management expertise and operational excellence will influence teams’ decisions and drive secure and scalable solutions. You should be passionate about delivering great customer experiences and changing the way customers leverage AWS services.  

  

Builders at Amazon work on real world problems on a global scale, own their systems end\-to\-end, and influence the direction of our technology that impacts hundreds of millions customers around the world. Join a team of super smart, customer obsessed builders that think big and have fun.  

  

A day in the life  

In this role, you will own the planning and execution of a new service managing cross\-team and cross\-org development and delivery, participating in architecture decisions, design reviews, and represent our service to Senior and Executive leadership. You will work with software developers and networking engineers along with product managers and other oranizations to deliver new services and new features create the best in class solutions for our customers worldwide!  

  

Candidates must be comfortable with ambiguity and eager to embrace ownership and accountability.  

  

About the team  

About AWS
  

  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Why AWS?  

  

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge\-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one\-on\-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

Diverse Experiences

jobs.title: IDIQ Project Manager / Alteration & Tenant Improvement Manager
jobs.description:
About Us:

When military bases, national security agencies, federal buildings, healthcare facilities, and leading commercial clients in Washington D.C and across the nation need superior facility support services, we answer the call. We offer a unique combination of government experience and facilities expertise that has helped us earn a position as one of the country’s leading integrated service providers.
Job Summary:
EMCOR Government Services is seeking an experienced **IDIQ Project Manager / Alteration \& Tenant Improvement Manager (ATIM)** to support facilities operations at the FDIC Headquarters facilities in Arlington, Virginia and Washington, DC.
The ATIM is responsible for the planning, estimating, coordination, execution, and closeout of reimbursable work orders, tenant improvements, alterations, and small construction projects. The position serves as the primary point of contact for project execution and is responsible for developing scopes of work, obtaining competitive proposals, managing subcontractors, ensuring quality and safety compliance, and delivering projects on schedule and within budget.
The successful candidate will possess strong project management, customer service, estimating, contract administration, and construction coordination skills with experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in occupied commercial, institutional, or government facilities.
Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:
Include but are not limited to:* Manage reimbursable work orders, tenant improvements, alterations, small construction projects, and mechanical infrastructure replacements from initiation through closeout.
* Conduct site walks and assessments to develop project scopes and identify project requirements.
* Review architectural, structural, mechanical, and electrical drawings and specifications.
* Develop statements of work, bid packages, cost estimates, and project schedules.
* Conduct bidder meetings and site walkthroughs.
* Solicit, analyze, and evaluate subcontractor proposals.
* Coordinate project planning, mobilization, execution, and closeout activities.
* Oversee preparation and management of CMMS work orders supporting project execution.
* Manage subcontractor performance and ensure compliance with contract requirements, building codes, safety regulations, and security procedures.
* Coordinate project activities with FDIC stakeholders to minimize disruption to building operations.
* Ensure proper preparation and protection of work areas during construction activities.
* Monitor project schedules, costs, and progress to ensure timely completion.
* Perform quality assurance inspections and develop punch lists for completed work.
* Coordinate project commissioning, turnover, as\-built documentation, and closeout packages.
* Prepare project status reports and provide weekly updates on all active projects.
* Work closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, and FDIC personnel to ensure successful project delivery.
* Provide professional customer service and maintain effective communications with building occupants and government representatives.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements, cost savings, and enhanced service delivery.

**Interior Construction and Craft Services Oversight*** Manage interior construction projects including renovations, wall construction, demolition, finish work, painting, and carpentry projects.
* Coordinate activities of fixed\-fee painting and carpentry personnel and associated subcontractors.
* Assist with development and management of the periodic painting program.
* Coordinate painting and carpentry requests submitted through service requests and interior construction workflows.
* Ensure proper material procurement and accountability for project execution.
* Verify completed work meets project requirements, quality standards, and customer expectations.

**Safety and Compliance*** Ensure compliance with OSHA requirements, site safety procedures, and company safety policies.
* Conduct pre\-task planning and review project\-specific safety requirements.
* Ensure subcontractors maintain safe work practices and follow applicable permits and procedures.
* Support quality control inspections and corrective action activities as required.


Qualifications:
* Minimum five (5\) years of recent experience managing alterations, tenant improvements, construction projects, facility renovations, mechanical systems and infrastructure replacements, or similar project work.
* Experience coordinating subcontractors, multiple trades, and project schedules.
* Experience with cost estimating, project planning, and contract administration.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, mechanical, and electrical drawings.
* Experience preparing scopes of work, bid packages, and project documentation.
* Strong customer service and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Valid driver's license.
* Ability to obtain and maintain required government site access and security credentials.

**Preferred*** Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Facilities Management, Architecture, Business Management, or a related field.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience supporting Federal Government facilities.
* Experience with Maximo CMMS.
* Experience with RSMeans estimating.
* Experience managing interior construction, painting, carpentry, and facility renovation projects.
* Experience working in occupied commercial, institutional, healthcare, or government buildings.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities*** Project planning and scheduling
* Construction estimating
* CMMS
* Facilities management
* Contract administration
* Quality assurance/quality control
* Subcontractor management
* Risk and safety management
* Budget tracking and cost control
* Technical document review
* Stakeholder communication and customer relations


Equal Opp

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Intelligence Systems
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**



Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers' most pressing national security requirements.


**ABOUT THE JOB**



As an AIS Technical Program Manager, you will lead the development and/or integration of Anduril products and technologies with various government and industry partners. These projects will be diverse in nature and require you to be organized and flexible to adapt to changing situations. On one project, you may be working with the customer to clarify how each of its mission requirements can be met through Anduril's core products, including the plan, scope, and work required. In another situation, you may be helping to craft a vision with the customer or participating in technical working groups with a collaborative set of engineers to transform that vision into an operational reality. During all this, you must be able to successfully work with both external and internal stakeholders, communicate plans clearly to all parties, and support and coordinate across teams to achieve the desired end state.  

  

Success in this position also hinges on two key facets: 1\) systems and engineering mindset—the ability to understand and assess technical concepts—identifying system dependencies, interfaces, technical risks and the impact of key architectural decisions with the engineering team is a must; and 2\) an execution mindset—digging into the details, charting the path and owning the outcome. You will be expected to utilize your technical aptitude in conjunction with your program and project management skills to deliver the best outcome for Anduril and the customer.  

  

We are seeking a TPM with prior training and experience in a relevant engineering field to plan, direct, and lead internal and external program activities. The TPM will interact daily with program Chief Engineer to coordinate the execution of program initiatives and tasks—working alongside the rest of the team to meet the program's administrative, technical, and operational requirements.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**



As the TPM for AIS, you will own two major roles for the supporting program: Contract Deliverables and the Master Schedule.  

  

**Deliverables Owner:**


* Drive the contract deliverables process during the contract implementation period as well as during ongoing operations.
* Work with internal stakeholders and data management resources daily to ensure accurate development and timely submission of government deliverables, and ensure deliverables are contractually compliant, edited, approved, and submitted on time.
* Assist with the development of Forward\-Looking Metrics and Trend Analysis to produce informative, easy\-to\-assimilate reports from the operational reporting systems, including written summary reports for Management.
* This reporting also allows them to define, plan, coordinate and conduct a comprehensive set of product and subsystem level reviews, change boards, and audits to manage change incorporation.

#### **Master Schedule Owner:**


* Maintain schedule coherence and uniformity across multiple substantive teams, and multiple disconnected networks.
* Consulting with Program Managers and Engineering Leads to set up assignments, tasks, and subtasks.
* Developing, implementing, and maintaining an effective scheduling management system across one or more programs.
* Developing and coordinating an integrated master schedule (IMS) with internal departments and external stakeholders.
* Monitoring project timelines and deadlines.
* Identifying potential project schedule delays and facilitating intervention in a timely manner.
* Evaluating performance and preparing project progress reports based on schedule and cost performance.
* Accommodating updates and changes to project schedules.
* Recommending actions to keep projects within budget and completed on time.
* Keeping stakeholders informed of project timelines and deadlines.
* Work with proposal team to develop the IMS as needed.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Intelligence Systems
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**



Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers' most pressing national security requirements.


**ABOUT THE JOB**



As an AIS Technical Program Manager, you will lead the development and/or integration of Anduril products and technologies with various government and industry partners. These projects will be diverse in nature and require you to be organized and flexible to adapt to changing situations. On one project, you may be working with the customer to clarify how each of its mission requirements can be met through Anduril's core products, including the plan, scope, and work required. In another situation, you may be helping to craft a vision with the customer or participating in technical working groups with a collaborative set of engineers to transform that vision into an operational reality. During all this, you must be able to successfully work with both external and internal stakeholders, communicate plans clearly to all parties, and support and coordinate across teams to achieve the desired end state.  

  

Success in this position also hinges on two key facets: 1\) systems and engineering mindset—the ability to understand and assess technical concepts—identifying system dependencies, interfaces, technical risks and the impact of key architectural decisions with the engineering team is a must; and 2\) an execution mindset—digging into the details, charting the path and owning the outcome. You will be expected to utilize your technical aptitude in conjunction with your program and project management skills to deliver the best outcome for Anduril and the customer.  

  

We are seeking a TPM with prior training and experience in a relevant engineering field to plan, direct, and lead internal and external program activities. The TPM will interact daily with program Chief Engineer to coordinate the execution of program initiatives and tasks—working alongside the rest of the team to meet the program's administrative, technical, and operational requirements.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**



As the TPM for AIS, you will own two major roles for the supporting program: Contract Deliverables and the Master Schedule.

* Drive the contract deliverables process during the contract implementation period as well as during ongoing operations.

#### **Master Schedule Owner:**


* Maintain schedule coherence and uniformity across multiple substantive teams, and multiple disconnected networks.

* Identifying potential project schedule delays and facilitating intervention in a timely manner.

* Recommending actions to keep projects within budget and completed on time.
* Keeping stakeholders informed of project timelines and deadlines.

jobs.title: Cyber Threat Analyst
jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**


Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.


##### **About The Role**


Peraton is seeking a Cyber Threat Analyst in our Linthicum, MD office in support of our Department of Defense (DoD) customer as part of a highly talented, highly motivated, and high\-performing team. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of cyber investigations, digital forensics, cyber threat analysis, and mission support in a dynamic and collaborative environment. The successful candidate will contribute to protecting national security interests by leveraging technical expertise, analytical skills, and innovative problem\-solving to address complex cyber challenges. Individuals who are passionate about cybersecurity, committed to excellence, and eager to make a meaningful impact are encouraged to apply.

  

Key Responsibilities:


* **Cyber Threat Analysis**: Analyze and interpret cyber threat intelligence with a focus on threats impacting the Defense Industrial Base (DIB). Identify potential risks and vulnerabilities affecting defense contractors and their supply chains.
* **Reporting**: Prepare detailed reports and briefings on cyber incidents, threat analysis, and investigative findings with particular emphasis on impacts to the DIB. Communicate findings and recommendations to senior officials and stakeholders.
* **Incident Response**: Triage, analysis and support incident response activities related to cybersecurity incidents affecting the DIB, including detection, analysis, and mitigation of breaches or attacks.
* **Collaboration**: Work closely with DIB and interagency partners to share information and coordinate response efforts. Facilitate communication and support to defense contractors as needed.
* **Tool Utilization**: Use cybersecurity tools and technologies to conduct fusion analysis; performs queries, pivots on indicators, and research malware characteristics (Message\-Digest Algorithm 5 (MD5\), Secure Hash Algorithm 1 (SHA1\), file size, file name, file paths, etc.). May leverage tools such as Analyst1, Kibana, Virus Total, Recorded Future, etc.
* **Continuous Improvement**: Contribute to the development and enhancement of cyber investigation methodologies, tools, and processes, with a particular focus on improving security within the DIB.
##### **Qualifications**


* **Clearance requirement:** Active/current Secret (TS/SCI preferred).
* **Education:** Associates degree and 7\+ years of experience; OR Bachelor’s degree and 5\+ years of experience; OR Master’s Degree and 3\+ years of experience. Or 0 years with PhD. However, four (4\) years of additional relevant experience or specialized training will be considered in lieu of a Bachelor’s degree. Relevant certifications (e.g., CYSA\+, CISSP, CEH, CISM) are preferred.
* **Experience:** Experience in cybersecurity analysis, incident response, or digital forensics. Requires a detailed knowledge of Department of Defense and service level (Army, Navy, Air Force) intelligence communities, including collection methods, production resources, and responsibilities. Knowledge of advanced persistent threats (APTs), Tactics Techniques and Procedures (TTPs)
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in cybersecurity tools and technologies (e.g., Virus Total, Domain Tools, SIEM, IDS/IPS, forensic analysis tools). Knowledge of operating systems, network protocols, cyber threat actors, cyber kill chain, Indicator of Compromises (IOCs) and MITRE ATT\&CK framework
* **Analytical Skills:** Requires skills and abilities in supervising the handling classified information. Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and provide actionable insights.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information and threat impacts to non\-technical audiences and stakeholders. Requires prior experience briefing information to decision\-makers and leaders. Uses Jira to track analysis tasks and communicate status.
* **Team Player:** Ability to work effectively in a team environment and collaborate with various stakeholders, including those in the DIB. Provides mentorship to less\-senior analysts.
##### **Details**


**Target Salary Range:** $86,000 \- $138,000\. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.


**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Amentum is seeking an experienced **Senior Program Manager (Sr. PM)** to lead efforts supporting projects both domestically (CONUS) and internationally (OCONUS). The Sr. PM will oversee every facet of the deployment, management, and operational oversight of contractor support personnel, ensuring the success of critical secure facility design, construction, and engineering support projects. The Sr. PM will be responsible for profit and loss (P\&L) accountability, driving financial performance on assigned projects and ensuring business targets are met.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Lead Program Management Efforts**: Provide comprehensive support by coordinating and collaborating across multiple tasks, activities, and requirements while addressing issues related to program scope, cost, performance, quality, schedule, and risk.
* **Strategic Planning and Implementation**: Develop detailed program plans, schedules, and documentation of requirements to ensure seamless execution of secure design and construction projects.
* **P\&L Management:** Maintain overall financial accountability for assigned programs. Create, monitor, and manage budgets; track project revenues, costs, and profits; and regularly report on financial status to senior leadership. Identify cost\-saving opportunities and implement strategies to achieve financial objectives while maintaining competitive service delivery.
* **Monitor and Adapt to Customer Needs**: Review customer contract requirements and feedback to proactively adjust program strategies. Identify issues, mitigate risks, and ensure timely delivery of services that meet or exceed customer expectations.
* **Performance Monitoring**: Use program management best practices to monitor cost, schedule, and performance metrics, identifying variances and implementing necessary corrective actions.
* **Personnel Management**: Identify, recruit, and propose highly skilled, cleared personnel to meet mission\-critical requirements expeditiously. Ensure continuity of support during personnel changes, while effectively aligning task order staffing.
* **Stakeholder Relations**: Serve as the primary customer point of contact, maintaining proactive, consistent, and transparent communication with key stakeholders.
* **Operational Oversight**: Monitor work processes, methods, budgets, and performance metrics to improve cost\-effectiveness, operational efficiency, and compliance. Oversee environmental, health, and safety functions to ensure safe work practices.
* **Continuous Improvement**: Continuously review systems, resources, procedures, and methods to improve operational effectiveness, efficiency, and overall customer satisfaction.

**Project Details:**

* Work will require the flexibility to lead operations efficiently in a variety of environments. The role will require frequent communication with customers in both CONUS and OCONUS project sites, with potential travel to these locations.

**Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):**

* **Clearance Required**: Active **TS/SCI with Polygraph**.
* **Education**: Bachelor’s degree in a related field (BS).
* **Experience**:


	+ 12\+ years of leadership experience managing large\-scale efforts valued at **$25M\+**, with demonstrated expertise in program management for secure design, construction, or related fields.
	+ Proven ability to lead teams effectively and adapt to dynamic project or customer requirements.
	+ Proven track record of managing complex projects and maintaining P\&L responsibility, ensuring financial targets are met.
	+ Strong interpersonal and written communication skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders and deliver stakeholder satisfaction.
* **Program Execution Skills**: Demonstrated expertise in budget management, scheduling, risk mitigation, logistics, contractor oversight, and quality assurance in alignment with high\-security requirements.
* **Technical Acumen**: Foundation in security requirements for design and construction in classified and operationally sensitive environments is desired. Experience with approved best practices in program and construction management required.
* **Financial Acumen**: Demonstrated ability to manage project financials, including budgets, schedules, resource allocation, and performance targets for profitability and success.
* **Certification**: Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Leadership Excellence**: Experience working on classified projects globally and successfully managing cross\-functional teams in high\-security government environments.
* Familiarity with DoD, IC, or U.S. Government construction, engineering, and logistics protocols is a plus.

**Additional Expectations:**

* **Travel**: Willingness and ability to travel to OCONUS locations as required to lead project delivery.
* **Work Environment**: Adaptable to challenging environments while maintaining composure and safety standards.
* **Commitment to Excellence**: Demonstrates the highest ethical, professional, and performance standards while ensuring all projects are executed with precision and in compliance with classifications, industry standards, and client demands.


Join Amentum in this rewarding role where you’ll make a tangible difference on mission\-critical secure infrastructure projects around the world.

**Who We Are:**  

Kudu Dynamics is Leidos Owned Company, forged out of a decade of experience in computer network operations and staffed with talent who have built, overseen, and enhanced capabilities throughout the entire USG arsenal. Our team of hackers and engineers have experience spanning centuries of research, development, and operations missions \- across desktop, mobile, IoT, and embedded platforms. Kudu Dynamics, a Leidos company is uniquely qualified to anticipate tomorrow’s threats and build the next generation of capabilities.


We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead execution across the teams developing an AI\-powered, autonomous vulnerability operations platform. The role sits between vulnerability researchers, software engineers, machine learning engineers, and government stakeholders, and is responsible for translating an evolving technical capability into a product delivered on a predictable release cadence.


Responsibilities could span roadmap and release planning, dependency management across model providers and third\-party components, and coordination of accreditation and deployment timelines for a range of implementation environments and diverse customer stakeholders.
