jobs.title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.



Thomas, a Xometry company, is the leading platform for industrial sourcing and digital marketing. We help manufacturers grow their businesses through high\-impact digital advertising, SEO, and content marketing services. This role is critical to maintaining the data integrity and lead flow that keeps our Sales and Marketing engines running at scale.  

  

We're looking for a seasoned analytics leader to serve as a strategic partner to Sales leadership and the broader executive team, turning complex, ambiguous data into the insight that drives revenue decisions. In this role, you'll own the Sales analytics function end\-to\-end — architecting the dashboard and data ecosystem, building the quota and forecasting models the business runs on, and setting the standards other analysts follow. You'll operate with significant autonomy, work directly with VP\- and C\-level stakeholders, and be trusted to define what "the right metric" even is when the business question is still fuzzy. This is a high\-visibility, high\-ownership role for someone who pairs deep technical fluency with sharp business judgment and the gravitas to influence senior decision\-makers.

  

### **How You'll Contribute:**


* Act as the primary analytics partner to Sales leadership and senior executives — proactively defining key metrics, surfacing strategic insights, and shaping decisions on quota, territory, headcount, and pipeline strategy
* Independently translate ambiguous, open\-ended business questions into structured analyses; identify the right question to ask when leadership hasn't fully defined it themselves
* Own the architecture, roadmap, and governance of Sales dashboards and reporting infrastructure — not just maintenance, but decisions on what gets built, deprecated, or redesigned as the business scales
* Design and continuously refine sales performance and quota models, incorporating historical trends, pipeline data, seasonality, and rep\-level variance to drive quota setting, attainment tracking, and revenue forecasting at the leadership and board level
* Build and evolve forecasting methodology, bringing statistical rigor (trend analysis, cohort analysis, scenario/sensitivity modeling) to what has historically been a more manual or gut\-driven process
* Set reporting standards and analytic best practices across the Sales analytics function; review and improve the work of other analysts, and mentor junior team members on technique, tooling, and stakeholder management
* Proactively identify risks, anomalies, and opportunities in the data — surfacing them to leadership before they're asked for, not just answering the questions in front of you
* Serve as the escalation point and liaison across Product, Marketing, Data Engineering, and Finance to resolve data discrepancies, align on definitions, and ensure a single source of truth across systems
* Lead or significantly contribute to cross\-functional data cleansing and data quality initiatives, including diagnosing root causes upstream in the CRM and data pipeline
* Represent analytics in planning cycles (annual quota setting, territory design, comp plan discussions), advising on trade\-offs with data\-backed recommendations

### **What You'll Bring to Xometry:**


* 5\+ years of experience in Sales/Revenue Operations, Business Analytics, or a related analytics function, with a strong focus on sales analytics, forecasting, or GTM strategy
* Advanced proficiency in SQL (complex joins, window functions, query optimization) and hands\-on expertise in Looker and LookML, including data modeling and semantic layer design (not Looker Studio)
* Advanced Excel/Sheets skills for modeling — able to build and audit complex, multi\-scenario financial and quota models from scratch
* Deep familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and a strong working knowledge of how sales data flows, breaks, and gets misreported across systems
* Demonstrated track record of advising and influencing senior (VP/C\-level) stakeholders using data — including pushing back constructively when the data tells a different story than leadership expects
* Exceptional storytelling and executive communication skills; able to distill complex, multi\-variable analysis into a clear narrative and recommendation for non\-technical audiences
* Strong statistical literacy — trend analysis, forecasting methods, and cohort analysis — with the judgment to know which technique fits which business question
* Proven ability to independently source, assess, and prioritize data and competing asks in a fast\-moving, ambiguous environment with shifting requirements
* Experience owning an analytics roadmap or reporting infrastructure end\-to\-end, including making build\-vs\-deprecate decisions
* Experience reviewing or mentoring the work of other analysts

### **Nice to Have:**


* Experience with dbt or a similar data transformation/modeling tool
* Working knowledge of Python or R for statistical modeling beyond what Excel/SQL can support
* Direct experience with sales quota design or compensation plan design
* Experience presenting directly to executive leadership or a board
* Experience partnering with Finance on revenue forecasting or annual planning cycles
* Prior experience managing or dotted\-line mentoring junior analysts


The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $110,000\- $120,000 annually \+ annual bonus depending on factors such as job\-related skills, relevant experience, and location. jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------



**What You’ll Be Doing**
Cadmus is seeking a **Senior Data Analyst** to support our financial commercial client. This candidate would partner with technical business consumers across Business Intelligence, Analytics, and other domains to help them adopt, implement, and maximize the value of new data solutions. They will work as a technical liaison, supporting requirements gathering, solution adoption, and ongoing enablement. This candidate will support delivery, requirements, and stakeholder training, awareness of key datasets to meet regulatory requirements.  

The role requires candidates come into the office 3 days per week in Tysons/McLean, VA.  

**Who We Are**
Cadmus provides government, commercial, and other private organizations worldwide with technology\-empowered advisory and implementation services. We help our clients achieve their goals and drive lasting, impactful change by leveraging transformative digital solutions and unparalleled expertise across domains.  

  

At Cadmus, we look for team players and problem solvers who are driven to use their unique perspectives and intellectual curiosity to help deliver breakthrough solutions that achieve transformative goals. As a member of our team, you'll collaborate with leading experts to support our clients across the globe. We offer competitive compensation, outstanding health care and retirement benefits, a vibrant and collaborative work environment, and ample opportunities for professional growth.  

  

Join Cadmus. Together, we are strengthening society and the natural world. For more information, visit cadmusgroup.com.
**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Provide excellent client service and Data Analyses in a large, big data Enterprise environment focused on the Mortgage Financial industry
* Spearhead consumer communications and managing both internal and external communications across program SharePoint site and Teams Channels
* Drive AI and prompt engineering initiatives
* Decompose and migrate legacy reports/views to modern platforms like Tableau and Python
* Support for development teams to champion consumer use cases and needs
**Qualifications**
------------------


* Bachelor’s degree and 10\+ years of professional experience
* Experience across the SDLC, including requirements, design, development, testing, documentation, training, deployment, and operations
* Solid understanding of system development methodologies and techniques, and an excellent grasp of database concepts and principles
* Solid knowledge of Agile methodologies and Proficiency in JIRA and Confluence
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, strong verbal, and written communication skills
* Advanced experience with SQL including query creation (such as select queries)
* Experience with Python, Snowflake, Informatica
* Experience in working in a Cloud Platform preferably AWS
* Expert proficiency in Microsoft products, such as Word, Excel, Visio, etc.
* Ability to capture and present operational metrics to Senior Management
* Ability to manage multiple tasks or projects at any given time
* Mortgage and Financial Data experience strongly preferred
  

**Additional Information:**  

Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States as a U.S Perm Resident or U.S. Citizen. As part of the hiring process, this position requires a pre\-employment drug test due to client requirements.  

  

Based on eligibility and job status, Cadmus offers an excellent benefits package to include: medical, dental, vision, company paid disability and life insurance, 401(k) program, paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, voluntary time off (VTO), tuition reimbursement, adoption assistance program, other optional benefits and various bonus programs.  

  

The salary range for this position is $140,000 \- $160,000\. The actual salary will be determined by several factors, including relevant work experience, education, skills, and market competitiveness.  

We value the critical role safety and health protocols contribute to everyone’s success at Cadmus, and work together to align and comply with all federal, state, and local safety and health mandates to ensure a safe and valuable work environment.

jobs.title: Identity Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**Description**


Leidos has a new and exciting opportunity for an Identity Intelligence Analyst in our Intel Sector Analysis Solutions Business Area (ASBA) in McLean, VA. Our talented team is at the forefront in Security Engineering, Computer Network Operations (CNO), Mission Software, Analytical Methods and Modeling, Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), and Cryptographic Key Management. At **Leidos**, we offer **competitive benefits**, including Paid Time Off, 11 paid Holidays, 401K with a 6% company match and immediate vesting, Flexible Schedules, Discounted Stock Purchase Plans, Technical Upskilling, Education and Training Support, Parental Paid Leave, and much more. **Join us and make a difference in National Security!**

The Identity Intelligence Analyst will be trained to support watchlist or screening and vetting efforts.


On the Watchlisting side this includes receiving, triaging, reviewing, and processing terrorist information/nominations from diverse US Government agencies. The Analyst will examine terrorism information from nominations to export following established criteria, standards, and policies. The Analyst will make recommendations regarding the nomination and watch listing process. The Analyst will support nomination QA/QC reviews.


While supporting the Screening \& Vetting mission the analyst will be responsible for screening and vetting individuals traveling to the US by reviewing non\-immigrant and immigrant Visa applicants against TIDE and other IC databases. Responsibilities will include using appropriate tools and analytic tradecraft to evaluate, analyze, and integrate relevant identity information to reveal foreign traveler links to terrorism for the State Department adjudication and watch listing purposes. This role uses the call chain analysis process to determine relationships, patterns, trends, indicators, and warnings to identify and report CT intelligence gaps.

**Requirements:**

* Required TS/SCI clearance with Polygraph.
* Required U.S. Citizenship.
* BA degree and 2 – 4 years of prior relevant experience or Masters with less than 2 years of prior relevant experience. Additional years of relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Ability to be flexible to perform a wide variety of tasks, change focus quickly, and adapt to meet mission requirements.
* Experience working with MS Office tools.
* Experience working with IC tools and databases.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytic, and written and oral communication skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to accurately follow SOPs.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to obtain and maintain access to customer systems.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of IC organizations, policies, procedures, and requirements.
* Experience analyzing intelligence reports and cables.

Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay\-benefits.

**Securing Your Data**


Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment\-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment\-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCaree

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

--------------------


**CONTEXTE**


Le Project Manager Infrastructure intervient dans un environnement industriel multisites, au sein d’une organisation matricielle. Il contribue à la coordination et à la livraison de projets d’infrastructure en interaction avec plusieurs équipes internes et externes. Le rôle exige une compréhension des pratiques du domaine, une capacité à structurer l’activité et une autonomie importante pour garantir l’avancement, la qualité et la cohérence des projets

Piloter la coordination et l’exécution des projets : définir les objectifs, planifier les actions, attribuer les responsabilités, suivre l’avancement, analyser les écarts et préparer les rapports destinés au management. * Structurer périmètre, livrables, risques et planning.
* Coordonner les activités projet et superviser l’exécution.
* Synthétiser l’avancement et préparer les rapports de statut.
* Maintenir des interactions efficaces avec les parties prenantes.
* Contribuer, selon l’expérience, aux activités commerciales locales (représentation, création de demande, services clients).
* Analyses de données, suivi terrain et activités opérationnelles.

**COMPÉTENCES \& PROFIL**


* Master Ingénieur
* Min 10\-15 ans d’expérience.
* Compréhension solide des concepts et pratiques du domaine (projets, infrastructure).
* Capacité à planifier, coordonner, structurer et suivre des actions complexes.
* Forte autonomie, sens du jugement et aptitude à gérer des tâches variées.
* Créativité, adaptabilité et capacité à prendre des initiatives.
* Français courant
* Anglais courant (min B2\)

**QUELQUES RAISONS DE NOUS REJOINDRE**


* **Expertise de pointe**: travaillez sur des projets stratégiques aux côtés des plus grands innovateurs mondiaux, autour de technologies comme les énergies du futur, les biotechnologies, l’intelligence artificielle, ou encore les systèmes embarqués pour les véhicules autonomes.
* **Formation continue** : accédez à des contenus adaptés à votre rôle et à votre discipline, pour vous former en continu sur les dernières technologies. Grâce à notre Engineering Academy et nos campus digitaux, vous pouvez obtenir des certifications techniques ou industries reconnues mondialement.
* **Innovation à impact** : participez à des challenges comme Tech4PositiveFutures ou Future of X, qui financent des projets technologiques à fort impact sociétal et environnemental.

jobs.title: IT Security Analyst, Risk & Compliance 80–100 % (hybrid, befristet)
jobs.description:
Ob Cloud\-Service, KI\-Lösung oder neue Fachapplikation – Du beurteilst Informatikmittel und IT\-Dienstleister aus Sicht der Informationssicherheit, begleitest und gestaltest den Due\-Diligence\-Prozess mit und unterstützt die ZHAW dabei, dass Digitalisierung und Innovation an der ZHAW sicher und verantwortungsvoll umgesetzt werden.


**Departement:** Finanzen \& Services
  

**Arbeitsbeginn:** Per 1\.1\.2027 befristet bis 31\.8\.2027


**Aufgaben**
------------


* Durchführen von Due\-Diligence\-Prüfungen neuer Informatikmittel und IT\-Dienstleister hinsichtlich Informationssicherheit und Compliance
* Prüfen von Sicherheitsnachweisen, Zertifizierungen und Auditberichten (z. B. ISO 27001, SOC 2, ISAE 3402\) im Rahmen von Beschaffungen und Vertragsabschlüssen
* Mitwirken bei der Definition und Weiterentwicklung von Sicherheitsanforderungen für Informatikmittel und externe Dienstleister
* Durchführen und Begleiten von Sicherheitsprüfungen sowie Nachverfolgen der Umsetzung vereinbarter Massnahmen
* Schulen und sensibilisieren interner Mitarbeitender zur Informationssicherheit
* Beraten von technisch und nicht\-technisch versierten Mitarbeitenden hochschulweit
* Identifizieren von Handlungsfeldern zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Informationssicherheit
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem agilen ICT\-Team, den anderen Security\-Funktionen und dem Datenschutzbeauftragten der ZHAW.

**Profil**
----------


* Praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Informationssicherheit, IT Risk Management, Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC), IT\-Audit oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion
* Aus\- und Weiterbildungen im Bereich Informationssicherheit
* Gute Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Client\-, Serverbetriebssysteme, Netzwerk\- und Cloud\-Technologien, Generative AI und Agentic AI
* Nachweislich sehr gute Kenntnisse der Informationssicherheit, des Datenschutzes und von IT General Controls sowie die Fähigkeit, Risiken verständlich zu bewerten und pragmatische Massnahmen abzuleiten
* Analytische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit einer raschen Auffassungsgabe und einem ausgeprägten Qualitätsbewusstsein
* Sehr grosses Interesse an aktuellen Trends und Entwicklungen in den Bereichen Cyber Security sowie neuer Angriffstechniken und Schutzmassnahmen
* Kenntnisse relevanter Standards und Frameworks, wie ISAE 3402 Typ 2 bzw. SOC 1 Typ 2 und ISO 27001
* Sehr gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten, um komplexe technische Sachverhalte anschaulich darzustellen und zielgruppen\- und sachspezifisch vermitteln zu können
* Teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit einer selbstständigen, zuverlässigen und dienstleistungsorientierten Arbeitsweise
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  

**Dafür stehen wir**
--------------------


Die ZHAW Zürcher Hochschule für Angewandte Wissenschaften ist mit über 14'000 Studierenden und über 11'000 Weiterbildungsteilnehmenden sowie mit rund 3'700 Mitarbeitenden eine der grössten Mehrsparten\-Fachhochschulen der Schweiz.
  

  

Das Team ICT\-Sicherheit im Stab Finanzen \& Services verantwortet das hochschulweite Cyber\-Risikomanagement, digitale Compliance, ICT\-Notfall\- und Cyber Incident Management, Vendor Risk Management, das interne ICT\-Kontrollsystem sowie Security Awareness und leistet damit einen zentralen Beitrag zum sicheren und regelkonformen digitalen Hochschulbetrieb.
  

  

Die ZHAW setzt sich für geschlechtergemischte und diverse Teams ein, um Gleichstellung, Vielfalt und Innovation zu fördern.

Wir bieten hochschulgerechte Arbeits\- und Anstellungsbedingungen an und fördern aktiv die Personalentwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden und Führungspersonen. Eine detaillierte Beschreibung der Vorteile ist auf der Webseite «Arbeiten an der ZHAW» zu finden. Hier die wichtigsten Eckpunkte:

* Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst (Temporary)
jobs.description:
Simpson Strong\-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. We maintain a reputation as a trusted manufacturer, partner, and corporate citizen committed to our customers and employees.


Our founder, Barc Simpson established 9 Principles of Business we live out as company values and have made Simpson Strong\-Tie an inspiring place to work since 1956\. Our team of talented people are dedicated to our shared mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures.


Learn about our company culture directly from our team.

**YOU**
=======


This temporary 4–6\-month position offers an opportunity to play a critical role in advancing Talent Acquisition operations. As the Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst, you will serve as a strategic operations, analytics, and enablement partner for the Talent Acquisition team. You will translate recruiting data into clear insights, lead or support TA technology implementations, standardize processes and resources, and create scalable tools that improve hiring consistency, speed, quality, and candidate experience. This role partners closely with HR partners, hiring managers, HR operations, communications, and external vendors to turn strategy into practical execution.


This position requires a proactive, detail\-oriented problem solver who can manage complex projects, communicate clearly across audiences, troubleshoot systems and process gaps, and use data to influence continuous improvement across the recruiting lifecycle.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**
========================

**Talent Acquisition Analytics, Reporting and Insights (30%)**


Generate, analyze and communicate TA metrics that help leadership, recruiters, HR partners and business stakeholders understand recruiting performance, hiring trends and opportunities for improvement.

* Maintain and improve recurring and ad hoc reporting on requisition volume, time\-to\-fill/time\-to\-offer, offer approvals, source performance, recruiter workload, platform usage, referral and internal applicant activity, quality\-of\-hire inputs and early turnover trends.
* Prepare quarterly TA performance reviews, executive summaries, dashboards, and slide\-ready insights that highlight progress, risks, root causes and recommended actions.
* Maintain and enhance recruiter scorecards, operational tracking tools and KPI frameworks to support accountability, prioritization and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Analyze applicant funnel health, sourcing channel performance and location\-specific challenges to inform proactive sourcing, advertising and candidate flow strategies.

**TA Technology, Systems and Process Optimization (30%)**


Lead and support implementation, adoption and continuous improvement of TA systems and workflows, with a focus on scalable, compliant and user\-friendly recruiting operations.

* Serve as a key TA project partner for recruiting technology initiatives, including Paradox/Ty interview scheduling and referrals, SHL assessment integration, HiredScore implementation, Workday recruiting enhancements and related platform changes.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing, system troubleshooting, hypercare support, issue logs, enhancement requests, access questions and cross\-functional follow\-up with HR systems, IT and vendors.
* Partner with TA and business stakeholders to standardize intake forms, job description/job posting content, required vs. preferred skills mapping, stage definitions, candidate communications and disposition templates.
* Evaluate system adoption and process gaps, recommend improvements, and develop scalable solutions that reduce manual work, improve consistency and strengthen candidate and hiring manager experience.

**Program, Project and Change Management (25%)**


Plan, coordinate and execute TA programs and strategic initiatives from concept through rollout, ensuring stakeholders are aligned, resources are ready, and adoption is supported.

* Update and maintain the Talent Acquisition Playbook, Hiring Manager Portal resources, job aids, FAQs, templates, process documentation and operating standards for recruiters, HR partners and hiring managers.
* Develop and deliver training and change\-management materials for new TA processes and tools, including live sessions, My Workbench content, recordings, guides, communication drafts and follow\-up resources.
* Support structured interviewing, hiring events, dedicated interview pool pilots, first\-year turnover improvement work, candidate experience initiatives and quality\-of\-hire measurement efforts.
* Manage project plans, agendas, meeting cadences, action items and stakeholder updates to keep cross\-functional work moving and aligned to TA priorities.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Recruiting Operations Partnership (15%)**


Act as a central coordination point across TA, HR, business leaders and external partners to strengthen recruiting operations, vendor effectiveness and stakeholder experience.

* Partner with recruiters, HRBPs and hiring managers on recruiting process improvements, branch/location hiring challenges, priority requisitions and manager communication needs.
* Manage or support vendor relationships and utilization for platforms and partners such as Paradox, Workday, SHL, HiredScore, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed and related recruiting tools.
* Support recruiter and hiring manager enablement through clear communication, meeting facilitation, resource sharing, troubleshooting and escalation of system or process issues.
* Contribute to employer brand, employee referral, social media spotlight, community outreach and candidate communication initiatives that improve attraction and engagement.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Data Analytics, Communications, Organizational Development or a related field required.3\+years of experience in Human Resources:

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world's most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production\-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.



Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

**Purpose**
-----------



Machine Development operates at the intersection of complex hardware, software, manufacturing, and operations, where successful execution depends on many teams moving together against shared technical and business outcomes. The Staff Technical Program Manager exists to create the clarity, structure, and operating discipline needed to make that happen.



This role drives the integrated execution of Machine Development programs by translating complex and often ambiguous objectives into clear plans, priorities, ownership, milestones, and decisions. The Staff TPM connects work across functions, ensures risks and issues are surfaced and resolved early, and gives teams and leaders the visibility needed to understand performance and make informed tradeoffs.



Success in this role means Machine Development executes more predictably, problems are identified and closed faster, cross\-functional teams stay aligned, and the processes and operating systems supporting execution become increasingly scalable and effective over time.


**The Role**
------------


* Own integrated program schedules, roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, risks, and high\-level development \& execution plans.
* Identify and actively manage program risks, issues, blockers, and dependencies.
* Build and continuously improve scalable business processes, operating cadences, tools, and program controls.
* Drive cross\-functional execution including triage and coordination such as change requests.
* Drive action\-item ownership, escalation, decision\-making, and closure.
* Enable successful change and configuration management.
* Provide clear program status, performance, tradeoffs, and recovery plans to stakeholders and leadership.
* Support coordination of technical and operational readiness for major releases, builds, qualifications, and deployments.
* Lead ad hoc, high\-priority initiatives that require additional structure, coordination, or cross\-functional execution.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------


* Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls
* Bachelor's degree in engineering or related technical field.
* 6\+ years of technical program, engineering, manufacturing, or product development experience.

Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production\-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **About the Job**



We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to own program delivery across our ERP/Oracle technology team. This role is accountable for the full lifecycle of ERP initiatives, from initiation through closure ensuring scope, schedules, and stakeholders stay aligned as we move at speed.  

  

The ideal candidate turns complexity into clarity and drives outcomes independently. You identify ambiguity, establish structure, and move initiatives forward without waiting for perfect direction. You don't need to be an ERP developer or technical architect, but you're technically fluent enough to coordinate effectively with functional analysts, developers, integration teams, security teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.  

  

We're moving fast to deliver software that matters. If you thrive in high\-tempo environments and want your work to have real\-world impact, this is the role for you.


### **What You'll Do**


**Program Ownership**


* Own applicable ERP initiatives across the full program lifecycle: initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, delivery, and closure
* Manage scope, schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and action items with proactive follow\-through and escalation when blockers arise
* Ensure every initiative has clear objectives, an owner, requirements, acceptance criteria, documentation, and completion criteria
* Manage multiple concurrent ERP initiatives with competing priorities


**Cross\-Functional Partnership**


* Work closely with Finance, Accounting, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain ERP teams to translate business priorities into organized, executable technical work
* Coordinate across business process owners, ERP functional teams, technical development teams, integration teams, security/access teams, external vendors, and leadership
* Lead working sessions, status meetings, planning sessions, and decision\-making forums
* Maintain proactive communication with stakeholders, ensuring they have what they need to make decisions


**Work Management and Backlog Ownership**


* Maintain the ERP team's work\-management system and program backlog, ensuring items have accurate priorities, owners, status, timelines, dependencies, supporting documentation, and next steps
* Support backlog hygiene and prioritization, and produce status reports and executive summaries
* Keep current with project documentation and ensure Jira reflects accurate project status
* Interface with vendors on scheduling, deliverables, and contract alignment (non\-budgetary)

### **Required Qualifications**


* 5\+ years of project or program management experience, including meaningful experience supporting ERP systems, enterprise applications, or technical business systems

Relevant experience with an enterprise ERP platform * \- Oracle Fusion experience preferred; experience with another large\-scale platform such as SAP is also relevant

* Strong written and verbal communication, including executive\-level status reporting
* Strong organization, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate independently
* Ability to identify ambiguity, establish structure, and drive decisions without waiting for perfect direction
* Hands\-on experience with Jira and Confluence

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* PMP or comparable project/program\-management certification
* Experience in fast\-paced technology, manufacturing, aerospace, or defense environments

* Planning and defining program goals and devising methods to accomplish them, developing in\-depth knowledge of owner objectives, contract terms, and airport policies.
* Planning, directing, supervising and controlling the execution of all technical, fiscal, and administrative functions of the assigned project.

* Managing project scope to meet or exceed project goals and objectives.
* Abilities to identify and study options to complex design, operational or constructability issues.
* Ability to conduct field surveys and investigations to capture detailed and accurate field conditions. This information shall be used to enable strategic design and construction decisions.

* Monitoring and leading efforts related to the permitting process required by the design team and contractor.
* Becoming thoroughly familiar with required contractual obligations and technical aspects of all facilities to be erected.

* Work with designers, contractors and stakeholders to develop the overall planning of construction activities and identify critical milestones and priorities.
* Prepare reports summarizing progress of pre\-construction activities for senior management.
* Review change proposals for contractual compliance and alignment with fair market value.
* Reviewing pay applications to ensure proper verification of completed work and compliance with contract requirements.
* Work with the Asset Renewal management team to devise and execute action plans to rectify potential cost overruns or delays, or to accommodate significant changes to the scope of work.
* Assure that current and timely Task Orders and Change Orders are documented and administered properly.
* Participate in all necessary coordination meetings with designers, contractors and stakeholders.

  

**Hardware/Software Knowledge*** Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and Bluebeam.
* Familiarity with Project Management Information Systems.
* Ability to work in CAD or REVIT preferred.


  

**Professional Experience/Other Qualifications:*** 15 years or more experience, preferably on airport projects
* Experience with projects more than $50 million in value
* Experience with various delivery methods, including Design\-Bid\-Build, Design\+CMAR and Design/Build
* Proven ability to perform in a management capacity
* Excellent written and oral communication skills and a thorough knowledge of industry practices and regulations

**Required Education/Training:*** Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Aviation, Business, Engineering, Construction Management, Planning or other related technical field required
* Master's degree preferred
* Relevant professional licensure and/or certification are strongly preferred. Certifications may include AAAE, LEED, PE, PMP, AICP, etc.

**Anticipated Salary Range:** $193,000 \- $205,000  

The offered salary will be based on the applicant's qualifications, education, experience, and work location.

jobs.description:
Our client, the world's leading entertainment streaming service, is looking for a **Program Manager, TA Ops.**


This is an **on\-site 12\-month contract.** Candidates should be within commuting distance and available to work on\-site occasionally at one of the following office locations: Los Gatos, Los Angeles, or New York, and must be authorized to work in the U.S. Candidates must not hold H\-1B visa status. * Act as a trusted partner to Recruiting leadership and cross\-functional teams. Represent the recruiting function in projects, drive process optimization, influence decision\-making, and provide SME\-level guidance on recruiting operations, tools, and workflows.

Drive continuous improvement of our recruiting technology stack by identifying gaps, evaluating processes, and creating impact through partnerships across Talent.

* Actively participate in post\-mortems to assess project outcomes, identify areas for improvement, and drive enhancements in project management processes and methodologies across global TA.

 **Required Qualifications**

* Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to inform strategic decision\-making, backlog prioritization, and solution development; familiar with Agile and Design Thinking methodologies.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to solve complex challenges, utilizing critical thinking and analysis.
* Experience supporting technology or process implementations and managing complex stakeholder groups.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to extract insights from data, identify trends, develop recommendations, and create detailed action plans.
* Proven ability to successfully manage multiple projects simultaneously with minimal oversight.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive), Slack, and Asana.
* Experience with Workday HCM and ATS systems is required.
* Eightfold experience is strongly preferred.
* Understanding of recruiting processes, systems, and lifecycle workflows; ability to operate as a subject matter expert (SME) strongly preferred.

jobs.title: IT Project Manager, IT PMO
jobs.description:
**About Monster Energy:**
-------------------------



Forget about blending in. That's not our style. We're the risk takers, the trailblazers, the gamechangers. We're not perfect and we don't pretend to be. We're raw, unfiltered, and a bit unconventional. Our drive is just like our athletes, unrivaled. The power is in your hands to define what success looks like and where you want to take your career. It's not just about what we do, but about who we become on along the way. We are much more than a brand here. We are a way of life, a mindset. Join us.


**A Day in the Life:**
----------------------



At Monster Energy, we move fast, push limits, and never settle for status quo — and our IT team is no different. We're looking for a Project Manager to join our IT PMO team and be the driving force behind technology projects that keep our business unstoppable. In this role, you'll lead IT projects from kickoff through completion, working closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to keep initiatives on track, on budget, and aligned with company goals. You'll bring structure and clarity to complex projects, helping our teams move forward with focus and confidence. You will operate independently with minimal oversight, driving cross‑functional alignment across business and IT while influencing stakeholders and executives. If you enjoy solving problems, keeping people aligned, and helping technology run smoothly behind the scenes, join us and help fuel what's next.


**The Impact You'll Make:**
---------------------------



* Develop comprehensive project plans, including scope, schedule, budget, resource allocation, and risk management strategies.
* Lead cross\-functional project teams composed of IT staff, business stakeholders, and third\-party vendors through all phases of the project lifecycle — initiation, planning, design/requirements gathering, development (including integration coordination), QA testing, UAT, and closure.
* Serve as the primary liaison between business sponsors, technical teams, and executive leadership, ensuring alignment on objectives, priorities, and expectations.
* Track and report project status, milestones, budget performance, and key metrics using PMO standard tools and templates (e.g., dashboards, RAID logs, status reports).
* Identify, assess, and manage project risks and issues, escalating appropriately and driving resolution in a timely manner
* Manage project scope and change control, evaluating change requests for impact on schedule, cost, and resources.
* Facilitate project meetings, including kickoffs, status updates, steering committee reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ensure adherence and adoption of PMO governance standards, methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, hybrid), and documentation requirements.
* Coordinate resource planning and allocation with functional managers to ensure project staffing needs are met.
* Manage vendor, SI, and contractor relationships, including scope adherence, deliverables, and contract compliance.
* Support budget forecasting, tracking, and reconciliation for assigned projects.
* Drive post\-implementation reviews and lessons\-learned sessions following a major release to support continuous improvement of PMO practices.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date project documentation in the PMO's project management system.
* Act as an ambassador for the PMO and project management functions.


**Who You Are:**
----------------



* Bachelor's degree in project management, business administration, information technology, or related field is required. Advanced degree preferred
* 5\+ years of experience managing complex, enterprise\-grade IT projects with multi\-system dependencies. Preference within a formal PMO structure.
* Experience working within IT environments and familiarity with software development lifecycle (SDLC) and enterprise\-grade applications.
* Experience managing Salesforce platform projects, including implementations, enhancements, integrations, data flows, and ongoing application management.
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently with minimal oversight.
* Proven ability to drive cross\-functional alignment across business and IT and influence stakeholders and executives without direct authority.
**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Scrum, hybrid approaches)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple, concurrent priorities
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams without direct authority and drive accountability across departments.
* Solid understanding of budgeting, financial tracking, and resource management principles.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proactive approach to risk identification and mitigation.
* Strong vendor and SI partner management skills specific to Salesforce delivery
* Proficient with Microsoft Suite and project management tools. ClickUp and LucidChart or equivalent preferred.


For United States applicants:  

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities  

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.  

Read our privacy policy here: Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Data Analyst- S&OP
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

A Reporting Data Analyst, you will drive the reporting and analytics behind our sales and operations planning (S\&OP) process for our portfolio of Adventure Sports brands, delivering insights across demand, supply, and inventory — leveraging AI tools embedded throughout how we analyze data and report on it.


You will partner with demand and supply planning, operations, finance, and commercial teams to build dashboards and recurring S\&OP deliverables, consolidating large data sets from disparate, fragmented sources that require cleansing and reconciliation into clear narratives on risks, opportunities, and trends. AI fluency is a core requirement: you will be expected to actively use and continuously expand your use of AI tools across the reporting workflow.


This position reports to the Director of S\&OP and is based out of our Irvine, CA office.


As the **S\&OP Data** **Analyst,** you will have an opportunity to:


**S\&OP Reporting \& Cadence**

* Support the monthly and weekly S\&OP reporting cycle across demand, supply, inventory, and executive review meetings.
* Build, maintain, and distribute recurring reports and dashboards that summarize plan vs. actual performance, forecast accuracy, and key supply chain KPIs.
* Prepare clear, executive\-ready PowerPoint summaries and pre\-reads that highlight trends, risks, and recommended actions.
* Maintain reporting calendars, trackers, and QA checklists to ensure on\-time, accurate deliverables.
* Use AI tools to draft executive narratives, summarize variances, and accelerate the production of recurring S\&OP deliverables.

**Demand, Supply \& Inventory Analytics**

* Develop analyses that improve visibility into demand signals, supply plans, inventory positions, and service levels.
* Track forecast accuracy, bias, MAPE, and other planning KPIs across categories, channels, and SKUs.
* Monitor inventory health metrics including weeks of supply, excess and obsolete risk, and stockout exposure.
* Partner with planning and operations to run root\-cause analysis on plan deviations, surface early warnings, and quantify business impact.
* Apply AI\-assisted analysis to detect anomalies, explain drivers of forecast and inventory variance, and generate plain\-language insights from large data sets.

**Dashboards, Tools \& Data**

* Design and maintain Power BI dashboards and self\-service reporting for supply chain and S\&OP stakeholders.
* Leverage Microsoft Copilot and other AI tools to accelerate analysis, summarization, and reporting workflows.
* Partner with IT and data teams to validate source data, improve data quality, and document reporting logic.
* Consolidate, scrub, standardize, and reconcile data from ERP, planning, finance, commercial, and external partner systems into a trusted reporting view.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and reduce cycle time on recurring deliverables, with a strong bias toward AI\-driven automation.

**Insights \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Translate data into clear insights and recommendations that inform S\&OP decisions and operational priorities.
* Partner with finance to reconcile operational performance to financial outcomes and forecasts.
* Support ad hoc analyses for leadership, including scenario modeling and business case support.
* Document standard definitions and reporting playbooks to drive consistency.
* Champion AI adoption across the supply chain and S\&OP function — share prompts, workflows, and use cases that help peers work faster and smarter.

**You have:**

* 3–5 years of experience in business analytics and reporting roles, supply chain or operations analyst
* Hands\-on experience supporting recurring reporting cycles in a manufacturing or consumer products environment.
* Strong understanding of S\&OP processes, demand and supply planning concepts, and core supply chain KPIs.
* Bachelor's degree in supply chain, operations, business, analytics, finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proficiency in Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, and dashboard design (required).
* Familiarity with ERP and planning systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis, or similar).
* Working knowledge of forecast accuracy, inventory, and service\-level KPIs.
* Thrives in dynamic environments where data is fragmented across disparate systems and routinely needs to be scrubbed and reconciled before analysis, with the ability to translate findings into clear recommendations.
* Enthusiasm for AI and experience using Microsoft Copilot or similar tools to enhance reporting and analytics productivity, with a willingness to keep expanding that skill set.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

jobs.description:

**Position:** Full time

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Business Analyst bridges the gap between Information Technology and business operations by managing, optimizing, and expanding the YMCA's critical business applications, including Daxko, Dayforce, CampDoc, and related systems. This position serves as the primary liaison between end users, vendors, and IT leadership to drive continuous improvement in application performance, data integrity, business processes, and user adoption.

*OUR CULTURE:* Our mission and core values are brought to life by our culture. In the Y, we strive to live our cause of strengthening communities with purpose and intentionality every day. We are welcoming: we are open to all. We are a place where you can belong and become. We are genuine: we value you and embrace your individuality. We are hopeful: we believe in you and your potential to become a catalyst in the world. We are nurturing: we support you in your journey to develop your full potential. We are determined: above all else, we are on a relentless quest to make our community stronger beginning with you.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Serve as the primary system administrator and subject matter expert for Daxko CRM and associated YMCA business applications, including Dayforce, CampDoc, and others as assigned.
* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from stakeholders across YMCA departments.
* Configure, test, and deploy application enhancements, workflows, and integrations in coordination with vendors and IT leadership.
* Develop and maintain system documentation, including user guides, process flows, standard operating procedures, and training materials.
* Provide end\-user training, support, and troubleshooting for supported business applications.
* Manage vendor relationships, including escalation of support tickets, evaluation of release notes, and coordination of upgrades.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation through better utilization of existing application capabilities.
* Produce regular reporting and dashboards from business systems to support leadership decision\-making.
* Collaborate with the Director of Information Technology on project planning, prioritization, and technology roadmap initiatives.
* Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance within managed systems.
* Participate in new application evaluation and onboarding, including needs assessments and vendor demonstrations.
* Coordinate and execute user acceptance testing (UAT) for system updates, integrations, and new features.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

*Personal Growth:* Pursues self\-development that enhances job performance. Demonstrates an openness to change, and seeks opportunities in the change process. jobs.description:

Lime is hiring a Sr Program Manager, Repair Operations to build and scale the operating system for Repair Operations worldwide. We’re looking for a global transformation leader who can align markets around common operating standards and lead measurable improvements in repair quality, efficiency, and compliance. This pivotal role brings together continuous improvement, tooling, training, data, and cross\-functional execution to build repeatable systems and help teams deliver consistent results at scale.


You will lead a globally diverse team of project managers in turning complex operational problems into scalable solutions—from diagnosing root causes and testing changes in live operations to validating impact and translating proven practices into global standards. You will partner closely with Local Operations, Central Operations, Supply Chain, Product, Engineering, Data, and Finance to build alignment, drive adoption, and embed sustainable change across markets.


This is a hybrid position with a requirement for candidates to reside in London, Paris, or Berlin to maintain effective collaboration across teams.

**What You'll Do:**

* Own the global Repair Operations program, including the priorities, operating model, governance, and change\-management approach required to improve performance across markets.
* Lead and develop the global Repair Operations team, setting priorities, operating standards, and a consistent performance\-management approach for a diverse team of project managers.
* Design and scale a common Repair Operations management system, including global standards, operating cadences, performance metrics, and continuous\-improvement routines.
* Drive operational change across a large, globally distributed organization of repair Operations warehouses and frontline teams.
* Build alignment and adoption across markets by influencing country and market leaders and securing the resources required to implement change.
* Partner Knowledge Sharing to own the global Repair Operations training and certification strategy, including role\-based curricula, standard work, train\-the\-trainer programs, certification requirements, and readiness criteria for core repair activities.
* Own the Repair Operations measurement framework and source\-of\-truth reporting, ensuring that metrics are clearly defined, trusted, actionable, with good frontline visibility, and used consistently by frontline teams and leadership.
* Own the Repair Operations tooling and equipment strategy, including operational requirements, standards, pilots, maintenance, and adoption. Partner with Product and Engineering to test solutions, validate impact, and scale tools that enable safe, repeatable, high\-quality repairs.


Core Performance Metrics


This role will own and be accountable for improving three dimensions of Repair Ops performance:

* Quality: Successful trips generated from each repair.
* Efficiency: High\-quality repairs completed per unit of labor and materials input.
* Compliance: Adherence to timekeeping, quality\-control, required\-maintenance, and spare\-parts processes.

**About You:**

* You have experience driving operational change in a large, globally distributed organization, particularly in repair operations, warehouse operations, fleet operations, or a similar environment.

* You are an effective cross\-functional leader who can communicate clearly with frontline operators, peers, stakeholders, and senior leaders and influence with and without direct authority.

Preferred Experience:

* 7\+ years of relevant experience in repair, warehouse, fleet, manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, operations, or program management, including experience leading people in fact\-paced, multinational environments and/or complex multi\-country or global programs.

**About the role :**


The IT Security Specialist plays a key role in safeguarding the organization’s EMEA retail IT landscape. The position covers Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC) activities within the BeNe Optical retail organization and Security Operations across the EMEA retail environment.

  

The role is embedded within the Global Security Operations Center (SOC) Level 2 team 3 working days per week, with a strong focus on security monitoring, incident detection, investigation, and response, leveraging modern SIEM and XDR technologies. 2 working days per week, the role is reserved for BeNe Optical retail for GRC Governance and Local security oversight.

  

**What you will do :**

  

**1\. Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC) and Operational Support. (BeNe Optical Retail Scope) :**


* Register, monitor, and report on objectives and activities within IT Security processes in collaboration with Benelux business and IT stakeholders.


* Maintain, configure, and continuously improve the Information Security Management System (ISMS) within GRC tooling.


* Register, track, and report security incidents within GRC tooling.


* Provide advice to the Benelux Retail Information Security Officer on information security measures.


* Support vulnerability management with a primary focus on operational remediation coordination and prioritization.


* Act as an information security advisor for new IT solutions and major changes to the IT Benelux infrastructure.

  

**2\. Security Operations (EMEA Optical Retail Scope) :**


* Operate as an embedded analyst within the Global SOC Level 2 team, supporting EMEA retail operations.


* Monitor, triage, investigate, and respond to security alerts and incidents, ensuring timely detection, containment, remediation, and escalation.


* Manage and investigate security alerts partially escalated by an external Level 1 (L1\) SOC via a ticketing system, while handling other alerts directly within the XDR platform.


* Utilize and optimize XDR platforms, including Microsoft Defender and Palo Alto Cortex, to enhance threat detection and response.


* Correlate events across endpoints, identities, networks, and cloud environments to identify advanced and persistent threats.


* Support the deployment, onboarding, and troubleshooting of XDR solutions, including endpoints, identities, networks, and cloud workloads.

  

**3\. Reporting \& Stakeholder Management :**


* Provide regular and ad\-hoc reporting to the Global IT Security Operations Manager and the Bene Optical Retail Information Security Officer.


* Act as a liaison between Global Security Operations and the Benelux retail organization, ensuring alignment between global operations and local governance requirements.


* Participate in IT security–related meetings and stakeholder consultations.

  

**What sets you apart :**

  

* Proven experience in Security Operations (SOC), preferably at Level 2\.


* Demonstrated expertise in XDR solutions, such as Microsoft Defender and Palo Alto Cortex.


* Experience with security incident detection, investigation, and response across endpoint, identity, network, and cloud environments.


* Solid understanding of common attack techniques, threat vectors, and incident response methodologies.


* Experience working in international or distributed environments, preferably within retail or large enterprise organizations.


* Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


* Experience in Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC) processes, including audits, ISMS management, and policy implementation.


* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

  

**Preferred Qualifications :**

  

* Knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST, or similar information security frameworks.


* Experience with vulnerability remediation coordination in enterprise environments.


* Dutch language proficiency (spoken and written) is preferred.


* Relevant certifications such as GCIH, GCED, SC\-200, AZ\-500, or Palo Alto certifications are a plus.

jobs.description:
In the journey of life, your career should make a difference.


At Inizio Evoke, we come together—to do the best work, in the best possible place. We're all in. Because it's everyone's role to make health more human™.


**About the Role**


We're looking for a Senior Program Manager to run the operating rhythm of Operatev — Inizio Evoke's enterprise AI platform — from the inside out.


This is a high\-visibility, cross\-functional role responsible for keeping the program on schedule and its status transparent. You'll own the connective tissue: sequencing work across Product, Development, Change \& Enablement, Support, Operations, Business Transformation, and Commercialization so that nothing blocks on an unowned handoff and everyone is working from the same picture of where things stand.


You will sit at the center of a program that is building and rolling out a platform to 1,200 people. That means competing priorities, real dependencies, and a delivery pace that doesn't slow down. You will bring strong program management fundamentals in a product development environment, thrive on clarity and structure, and know how to translate complex cross\-functional realities into reporting that actually drives decisions.


This is a remote role reporting to the Program Lead.

  



**What You'll Do:**


***Own Cross\-Team Sequencing***


* Map dependencies across functions — what depends on what, in what order — and monitor progress against that sequence
* Ensure handoffs are owned, surface unresolved blockers early, and drive items to closure or escalation
* Maintain visibility into the implications of sequencing decisions for Product, Development, and all downstream functions

***Run the Quarterly Planning Cycle***


* Gather functional inputs across all workstreams
* Facilitate commitment\-setting and document outcomes
* Translate quarterly commitments into trackable milestones and hold functions accountable to them

***Track Program Resourcing***


* Maintain visibility into where capacity is going against what's committed and manage the program's calendar to proactively address capacity challenges
* Surface trends and anomalies to program leadership before they become problems
* Oversee recruitment process, meeting with talent acquisition for updates and ensuring timely progress through stakeholder participation

***Set and Hold Stage Gate Standards***


* Define the gates work passes through and what evidence clears each one
* Keep functional cadences in sync without taking over internal functional processes (sprint practices, capability lifecycle, etc.)

***Run Delivery Forums***


* Facilitate the weekly initiative update and risk review
* Maintain the risk register and drive items to resolution or escalation
* Track progress against quarterly commitments and hold the reporting cadence

***Define Reporting Standards***


* Establish and maintain the data taxonomy that governs how each function reports its metrics
* Ensure functional outputs roll into one consistent program\-level picture rather than competing narratives

***Own Executive Reporting***


* Prepare and deliver the synthesized program view for executive and steering committee audiences
* Surface where delivery reality constrains what's being asked — clearly and with context

  

**What You'll Bring:**


* 7\+ years of experience in program management, delivery management, or PMO leadership — ideally within a technology platform, transformation, or product delivery context
* Experience running formal planning cycles (quarterly or release\-based) and translating outputs into trackable commitments
* Track record of building and maintaining executive\-level reporting that is trusted and acted on
* Comfortable managing budget and resource visibility — not ownership, but accurate tracking and surfacing of variance
* Background in professional services, agency, consulting, or regulated industry preferred (healthcare, life sciences, or similar)

***Skills***


* Strong program and project management fundamentals — dependency mapping, risk management, stage gates, and cadence management
* Highly organized: you make things visible, structured, and easy to act on
* Strong written and verbal communication; able to translate complexity into clean reporting without losing accuracy
* Comfortable operating in agile/iterative environments where priorities shift and the plan evolves
* Skilled facilitator — able to run productive cross\-functional forums without letting them drift

***Mindset***


* You keep things moving without needing to own everything
* You surface problems early and bring them forward with enough context for a decision
* You enforce standards consistently — not rigidly, but reliably
* You understand the difference between tracking and deciding, and you stay in your lane while making it easy for others to stay in theirs

  

**What We Offer**


* A central, high\-impact role in a program building something genuinely new — an enterprise AI platform designed to change how a 1,200\-person agency does its work
* Direct visibility to executive and steering committee leadership
* A cross\-functional operating environment where your work touches every part of the program
* The opportunity to define and own the operating standards that the program runs on

Inizio Evoke provides an exciting and flexible work environment, great compensation packages and outstanding company paid benefits including medical, dental, 401(k), tuition reimbursement and flexible time off.

**Company Description**  

Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.


Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.


Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.


We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

 **Job Description**  

Turner \& Townsend is seeking an **Associate Program Manager** to support pre\-lease technical due diligence for a confidential hyperscale data center client. You will work under a Program Manager to keep a portfolio of live deals organized, on track, and moving, while building toward ownership of your own deals.


This is an execution and organization role that builds into program management. You will own the tracking, follow\-up, and day\-to\-day structure across every deal you support, sit in on every deal call as the account's backstop, and progressively take on direct ownership of workstreams and sites as you demonstrate the judgment to run them. Deals move on short exclusivity windows and incomplete information. We are looking for people who bring order to that rather than waiting for it to settle.


Prior program or project coordination experience is expected. Data center, real estate, or construction exposure is a plus but not required. This is not an executive assistant role and not a purely administrative function. It is the operational backbone of the diligence process, and a defined path into full program management.


This role reports to a Program Manager and is based in San Francisco, with other locations and remote considered for the right candidate.

**Responsibilities**

* **Tracking and follow\-up:** Own the action item log across every meeting on your accounts. Assign owners, chase status, and close items out, escalating anything that stalls.
* **Risk log management:** Keep the risk register current for every site in your portfolio. Log new findings, confirm each has an owner and a next step, and follow up until closed.
* **Meeting management:** Build and distribute the agenda ahead of every standing call, keep it on track, and issue a recap and minutes the same day.
* **Deliverable tracking:** Track what is due from consultants and developers across every workstream, and chase it before it is late, not after.
* **Deal awareness and backstop:** Participate in every deal call across your portfolio. Serve as the backstop for each deal, whether you own it or not: know what is happening, what the open issues and risks are, and what needs to happen next. Backstop means knowing it and flagging it, not making the final call on it.
* **Communication and systems:** Keep the shared trackers and communication channels clean, concise, and accurate so the Program Manager, the client, and other account partners can find what they need without asking you first.
* **Client and reporting support:** Draft the first pass of client reports and status updates for the Program Manager to edit, so they are reacting to a draft, not starting from a blank page.
* **Process and tools:** Build and maintain the checklists and templates the account runs on, and improve them yourself when you find a gap.
* **Deal ownership:** As you ramp, take direct ownership of full workstreams or lower\-complexity sites end to end, bringing judgment calls to the Program Manager until you have earned the room to make more of them yourself.
* **Escalation:** Raise anything that looks wrong the same day it surfaces. Do not sit on an open question hoping it resolves itself.


SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

 **Qualifications**  

* Minimum 3 to 5 years of relevant experience. A degree is not required.
* **Prefer candidates that are located in/near San Francisco, CA that can come to the office 2 to 3 days a week but will consider remote for the right candidates.**
* Program or project coordination experience preferred. Data center, real estate, or construction backgrounds are a plus.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving, low\-information environment, with the organizational instinct to bring structure to it.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the polish to represent the account directly to clients and developer counterparties.
* A working understanding of, or willingness to quickly learn, what a data center is and how one gets built, including power, cooling, and long lead equipment.
* Enough command of program tracking and risk management to keep a portfolio organized without oversight.
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and reprioritize with incomplete information.
* A self starter who takes initiative, adapts quickly, and does not wait for a playbook.
* Technologically proficient, including MS Suite and Google Workspace. Comfort building and maintaining tracking tools is an advantage.
* Be able to understand and follow site HSSE policies.

 **Project/Program Specifications**

* **Market sector experience:** Data center development, mission critical facilities, or complex technical and hyperscale buildings preferred, not required.
* **Program specific responsibilities:** Tracking, follow\-up, meeting management, and risk log ownership across a portfolio of concurrent sites, building toward direct site ownership.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst (Temporary)
jobs.description:
Simpson Strong\-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. We maintain a reputation as a trusted manufacturer, partner, and corporate citizen committed to our customers and employees.


Our founder, Barc Simpson established 9 Principles of Business we live out as company values and have made Simpson Strong\-Tie an inspiring place to work since 1956\. Our team of talented people are dedicated to our shared mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures.


Learn about our company culture directly from our team.

**YOU**
=======


This temporary 4–6\-month position offers an opportunity to play a critical role in advancing Talent Acquisition operations. As the Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst, you will serve as a strategic operations, analytics, and enablement partner for the Talent Acquisition team. You will translate recruiting data into clear insights, lead or support TA technology implementations, standardize processes and resources, and create scalable tools that improve hiring consistency, speed, quality, and candidate experience. This role partners closely with HR partners, hiring managers, HR operations, communications, and external vendors to turn strategy into practical execution.


This position requires a proactive, detail\-oriented problem solver who can manage complex projects, communicate clearly across audiences, troubleshoot systems and process gaps, and use data to influence continuous improvement across the recruiting lifecycle.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**
========================

**Talent Acquisition Analytics, Reporting and Insights (30%)**


Generate, analyze and communicate TA metrics that help leadership, recruiters, HR partners and business stakeholders understand recruiting performance, hiring trends and opportunities for improvement.

* Maintain and improve recurring and ad hoc reporting on requisition volume, time\-to\-fill/time\-to\-offer, offer approvals, source performance, recruiter workload, platform usage, referral and internal applicant activity, quality\-of\-hire inputs and early turnover trends.
* Prepare quarterly TA performance reviews, executive summaries, dashboards, and slide\-ready insights that highlight progress, risks, root causes and recommended actions.
* Maintain and enhance recruiter scorecards, operational tracking tools and KPI frameworks to support accountability, prioritization and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Analyze applicant funnel health, sourcing channel performance and location\-specific challenges to inform proactive sourcing, advertising and candidate flow strategies.

**TA Technology, Systems and Process Optimization (30%)**


Lead and support implementation, adoption and continuous improvement of TA systems and workflows, with a focus on scalable, compliant and user\-friendly recruiting operations.

* Serve as a key TA project partner for recruiting technology initiatives, including Paradox/Ty interview scheduling and referrals, SHL assessment integration, HiredScore implementation, Workday recruiting enhancements and related platform changes.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing, system troubleshooting, hypercare support, issue logs, enhancement requests, access questions and cross\-functional follow\-up with HR systems, IT and vendors.
* Partner with TA and business stakeholders to standardize intake forms, job description/job posting content, required vs. preferred skills mapping, stage definitions, candidate communications and disposition templates.
* Evaluate system adoption and process gaps, recommend improvements, and develop scalable solutions that reduce manual work, improve consistency and strengthen candidate and hiring manager experience.

**Program, Project and Change Management (25%)**


Plan, coordinate and execute TA programs and strategic initiatives from concept through rollout, ensuring stakeholders are aligned, resources are ready, and adoption is supported.

* Update and maintain the Talent Acquisition Playbook, Hiring Manager Portal resources, job aids, FAQs, templates, process documentation and operating standards for recruiters, HR partners and hiring managers.
